description.zh: 方形牡丹纹象征着生命的繁盛与和谐的自然秩序。中央的牡丹花代表了富贵与繁荣，而四周对称的小花与叶片则寓意万物共生、和睦相处。方形的整体构图表现了稳定和均衡的宇宙观念，体现了唐代文化中天人合一的哲学思想。牡丹纹样的多层次装饰与秩序感不仅展示了唐代织绣工艺的高度成就，也传递了对繁荣昌盛、和谐安宁的美好追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: The circular peony pattern features a blooming peony as its main motif, arranged in a ring-shaped composition to achieve a harmonious decorative effect. The petals of the peony are layered, with smooth and flowing lines, presenting a full-bodied appearance. The central part of the petals is finely detailed, highlighting the details. The intertwined branches extend in various directions, complementing the blooming peonies, creating a lively scene. The circular border surrounding the pattern frames the entire design, maintaining a balanced and orderly appearance without losing its dynamic sense. The fluidity of the branches and the static beauty of the peonies create a harmonious contrast, adding visual tension to the overall composition.
description.zh: 该圆形牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主要意象，通过环形的构图展现出井然有序的装饰效果。牡丹花的花瓣层层叠叠，线条柔和而流畅，呈现出饱满的姿态，花心局部刻画细腻，展现出细节感。缠绕的枝蔓交错延展，与盛开的花朵交相辉映，构成一个生动的画面。外围圆形的边框将整个纹样框定，使画面规整而不失动感，枝叶的流动性与花朵的静态华丽形成巧妙的对比，为整体增添了视觉上的张力。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 圆形牡丹纹蕴含着生命力、自然和谐与万物循环的文化寓意。牡丹作为“花中之王”，自古以来象征着富贵与繁荣，表达了唐代对美好生活的向往。圆形的构图形式寓意圆满和永恒，与自然界的生生不息相契合。枝蔓的缠绕与延展则体现了生命的流动性和循环性，呈现出人与自然和谐共生的哲学理念，既传递了吉祥之意，也展现了唐代艺术追求自然美与装饰美相结合的审美高度。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该飞蝶牡丹花纹以盛开的牡丹为中心主体，枝叶繁茂，层次分明，展现出饱满的画面感。牡丹花的花瓣叠加紧密，流露出庄重而华丽的气质，周围的枝叶舒展自然，增强了整体的立体感与延展性。在构图中，四周的蝴蝶姿态轻盈，翩翩起舞，与牡丹形成了动静结合的画面效果。滴状的装饰元素点缀其间，进一步增加了画面的细节与动感。整体纹样布局对称，线条流畅，既有生动的自然美，又展现了雕刻艺术的精巧工艺。

description.en: The peony and butterfly motif on the stele conveys the cultural meaning of prosperity, harmony, and protection. The peony symbolizes prosperity and status, reflecting the Tang Dynasty's pursuit of flourishing and beauty. The fluttering butterfly symbolizes freedom and dynamism, while the flourishing flowers express the vitality of life and the harmony between nature and humanity. The stele carving, as a memorial art, not only enhances the aesthetic appeal but also carries a protective meaning, highlighting the Tang Dynasty's fusion of natural beauty and artistic beauty, as well as their profound desire for the eternal harmony of life and spirit.
description.zh: 飞蝶牡丹花纹蕴含了生命繁盛、自然和谐与守护庇佑的文化意义。牡丹作为富贵昌盛的象征，体现了唐代社会对繁荣与美好的追求；而轻盈飞舞的蝴蝶寓意着自由与灵动，与盛开的花卉共同表达了生命的活力和自然界的和谐共生。碑刻雕刻作为一种纪念性艺术，其装饰不仅提升了美感，更具有守护的意味，彰显了唐代对自然之美与艺术之美的高度融合，以及对生命与精神永恒的渴望。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony interlaced scroll design features a central cluster of blooming peonies with distinct layers of petals. The radial arrangement radiates outward, showcasing the vibrant and striking appearance. The interlaced scroll below is symmetrically distributed, with natural curling branches and leaves, creating a smooth and beautiful line. This combination of dynamic movement and static harmony highlights the interplay between radial arrangement and peony petals. The interplay of the interlaced scroll and the peony's fullness creates a visually striking effect. The overall composition is simple yet intricate, emphasizing decorative elements and symmetry, while highlighting the delicate and aesthetic qualities of Tang dynasty carving art.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为中心，花瓣层次分明，向外放射，展现出鲜艳夺目的姿态。牡丹下方的缠枝纹样呈对称分布，枝叶卷曲自然，线条流畅优美，形成了动感与静态的和谐结合。缠枝纹的延展性与牡丹花的饱满形成鲜明对比，给人以繁盛而生动的视觉效果。整体构图简洁但不失精巧，强调装饰性与对称性，凸显了唐代雕刻艺术的细腻与审美追求。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹表达了生命繁盛、自然和谐与守护的文化寓意。牡丹作为传统富贵与繁荣的象征，展现了唐代社会对美好生活的向往；缠枝图案延展交织，寓意生命的循环与自然界的生生不息。碑刻雕刻的装饰性不仅体现了建筑与雕塑的庄严和美感，还具有守护与震慑的功能，反映了唐代艺术对自然与生命的深刻理解以及对精神世界的崇高追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹为主体，呈现出对称的放射状构图，花瓣紧密围绕花心排列，层次分明且饱满圆润。每片花瓣边缘微微上扬，呈现自然的弧度，花瓣上刻画出细致的纹理线条，增强了花朵的立体感和装饰性。花心部分以密集的小花簇状纹理表现，犹如生命力充沛的核心。整体纹样简约但结构清晰，突出了牡丹的华美与庄重，展现出唐代艺术风格中对对称性和装饰美的高度关注。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹纹具有自然和谐、生命繁盛以及震慑与守护的文化意涵。牡丹自古以来象征富贵荣华与繁荣昌盛，其绽放的姿态体现了生命的旺盛活力。对称的花形设计寓意自然界的平衡与和谐，同时，装饰在建筑或器物上的牡丹纹常被赋予震慑与守护的象征意义，用以庇佑环境的安宁与和谐。该纹样不仅是对自然美的高度提炼，更承载了人们对吉祥与幸福的寄托。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: The peony design features a symmetrical composition with the flowers arranged in layers. The peony is centered, with petals unfolding in a circular manner. The petals are full and round, with smooth, flowing lines that convey elegance. Cloud patterns decorate the flowers above and on either side, creating a smooth transition from the petals to the cloud motifs. This adds depth and decoration to the design, enhancing the sense of movement and harmony. The contrast between the fluidity of the cloud patterns and the static opening of the peonies creates a striking visual effect, highlighting the interplay of movement and stillness. The design is simple and elegant, reflecting the typical features of Tang dynasty brick carving.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为主题，整体呈现出对称的构图形式。牡丹花居中，花瓣层层展开，造型饱满，线条圆润流畅，展现出优雅的曲线美。花朵上方和两侧饰以云纹装饰，卷曲的云纹形态与花瓣自然过渡，相得益彰，增添了纹样的立体感和装饰性。云纹的流动感与牡丹的静态开合形成鲜明对比，表现了动静相融的和谐美感。整体设计简洁、庄重，极具唐代砖刻工艺的典型特征。

description.en: Peony pattern with flowing cloud motifs, combining harmony with life flourishing, embodies awe and prosperity. Peonies symbolize prosperity, vitality, and flourishing, while the fluidity of the clouds convey the infinite vitality of nature. As a brick carving decoration, this pattern is often used in religious architecture or tombs, praising life and seeking protection of the soul and warding off evil spirits. This design integrates the aesthetic pursuit of the Tang Dynasty for nature and spirituality, reflecting the cultural connotations and craftsmanship of the era.
description.zh: 牡丹纹及其带有流动感的云纹结合，蕴含了自然和谐、生命繁盛和震慑的文化意涵。牡丹花象征着富贵、繁荣和生命力的旺盛，而云纹的流动性则传达出自然界运行的无穷生机。作为砖刻装饰，这一纹样常被用于宗教建筑或墓葬中，既体现了对生命的礼赞，也寄托了对灵魂守护与震慑邪祟的祈愿。该设计融合了唐代对自然之美和精神世界的追求，反映了时代的文化内涵与工艺水平。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为核心，整体呈现层叠放射状的构图，花朵饱满圆润，层次分明。花心部分细腻精致，向外展开的花瓣排列有序，边缘呈尖锐且柔和的波状线条，象征生命的蓬勃。纹样的线条流畅而均匀，注重对花朵造型的写实刻画，同时具有装饰性。整体设计结构紧凑，展现了唐代瓷器装饰艺术中对自然之美和工艺细节的高度关注。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹纹承载了自然和谐、生命繁盛以及循环的文化寓意。牡丹象征富贵和繁荣，其盛开的造型展现了生命力的旺盛与自然界的生生不息。此纹样作为瓷器上的装饰元素，不仅美化器物，亦隐喻着唐代社会对自然界运行规律与生命延续的深刻理解。瓷器装饰中以牡丹为主题，表达了对美好生活的追求与对自然之道的敬畏。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为核心，构图对称而规整。花朵居中，层层花瓣向四周绽放，呈现出丰富的层次感。外层花瓣卷曲舒展，线条流畅自然，边缘波浪状的设计增添了柔和感。花朵周围点缀着叶片和花蕾，形成动静结合的装饰效果，展现了自然界的和谐美。整体纹样简洁而不失细腻，线条流畅且富有节奏感，体现了唐代瓷器纹样工艺的高超技巧。

description.en: Peony pattern symbolizes prosperity, flourishing life, and vitality, while reflecting harmony and the cyclical nature of the world. The flowers bloom in layers, symbolizing the strength and continuation of life, while the leaves and buds add to the natural cycle and perpetual renewal. This pattern is used for porcelain decoration, reflecting the Tang Dynasty's praise of natural beauty and the aspiration for prosperity and harmony. As a porcelain pattern, peony also symbolizes protection and blessings, invoking good fortune and health.
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征富贵、繁荣与生命的旺盛，同时展现了和谐与自然的意境。花朵层层绽放，寓意生命力的强盛与延续，而叶片与花蕾的点缀则体现了自然界的循环与生生不息。此纹样用于瓷器装饰，不仅反映了唐代对自然美的礼赞，也体现了人们对富足与和谐生活的向往。作为瓷器纹样，牡丹纹还具有守护与祝福的象征意义，用以祈祷美好与安康。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为主题，采用对称的构图形式，整体呈辐射状。花心由密集的小花瓣组成，层次分明，展现出强烈的立体感。外层花瓣卷曲舒展，边缘流畅而富有动感，仿佛随风摇曳。花茎和叶片以蜿蜒的线条表现，其形态自然流畅，与主花相辅相成，形成了动静结合的视觉效果。整个纹样线条简洁流畅，雕刻细致，表现出唐代石刻艺术高度的工艺水平和对自然形态的写实追求。

description.en: Peony patterns symbolize prosperity and flourishing in Tang Dynasty culture, while their symmetrical and flowing designs highlight the harmony of nature and the dynamic cycle of life. The small petals at the center of the peony symbolize the gathering and blossoming of life, while the unfolding outer petals symbolize the development and continuation of life. Peony carvings on buildings are often used for decorative purposes, serving as protection for the structures and warding off evil spirits, while also reflecting people's wishes for a better life. By combining its use in Tang Dynasty architecture, this motif not only embodies aesthetic appreciation but also carries profound spiritual significance, reflecting the Tang people's reverence for nature and life.
description.zh: 牡丹纹在唐代文化中象征富贵和繁荣，而其对称与流动的设计则彰显了自然界的和谐与生命的动态循环。花心的小花瓣寓意生命的汇聚与绽放，外层花瓣的舒展象征生命的发展和延续。石刻牡丹纹常用于建筑装饰，具有守护建筑和震慑外来邪祟的功能，同时也寄托了人们对美好生活的祈愿。结合其在唐代建筑中的用途，该纹样既是审美体现，又具有深厚的精神内涵，反映了唐代人对自然与生命的尊崇。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony motif features a central arrangement of blooming peonies, with a symmetrical composition. The peonies have a rich variety of layers, with tightly packed petals that radiate outward, creating a visually stunning effect. The surrounding elements include scrolling foliage and leaves, which are arranged in a smooth, natural manner. The petals curl and the peonies bloom, creating a contrast between movement and stillness. The interplay of peonies and decorative motifs is harmonious, with intricate details that exhibit a rhythmic quality, reflecting the high artistic skill of the Tang dynasty stone carvings and their meticulous depiction of natural forms.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹为主题，整体构图饱满而对称。中央的牡丹花形态层次丰富，花瓣排列紧密，层层叠叠向外绽放，展现出繁盛的视觉效果。外围辅以卷草纹和叶片点缀，线条流畅自然，卷曲的叶片与盛开的牡丹形成动静结合的层次感。花与装饰纹样之间关系和谐，细节雕刻精致而富有韵律，呈现出唐代石刻艺术的高超技艺和对自然形态的细腻表现。

description.en: Peony has been revered as "the king among flowers" symbolizing prosperity, vitality, and flourishing. This motif, with its depiction of peonies in full bloom, praises the vitality and the aspirations for prosperity and flourishing. The scrolling foliage and leafy decoration symbolize the beauty of nature's cycles and harmony. As a decorative motif on stone carvings, its symmetrical and dignified composition conveys a sense of protection, invoking awe and guarding against evil, while also reflecting the Tang Dynasty's reverence for nature and life philosophy.
description.zh: 牡丹自古被誉为“花中之王”，象征富贵、繁荣和生命的旺盛。该纹样通过牡丹盛开的意象，表达了对生命力的歌颂和繁荣昌盛的期盼。而卷草纹与叶片的环绕装饰，象征自然界的循环与和谐之美。作为石刻建筑装饰纹样，其对称而庄重的构图传递了一种守护的意味，用以震慑邪恶，守护建筑的圣洁与安宁，同时也体现了唐代社会对自然与生命哲学的崇拜与追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主体，呈现出层次丰富、饱满圆润的构图。牡丹花心居于视觉中心，花瓣层层叠叠向外延展，每片花瓣形态饱满，边缘圆滑，排列紧密，表现出盛放的态势。花瓣内侧的细密线条刻画了花瓣的纹理，增添了纹样的细腻感和立体感。外围的花瓣形成对中心花心的环绕，增强了整体的辐射效果，展现出繁茂和生机勃勃的视觉美感。纹样整体注重对称性，结构紧凑，线条流畅且富有节奏感。

description.en: Peony has been associated with prosperity and flourishing since the Tang Dynasty, symbolizing vitality and natural harmony. The symmetrical composition and flowing texture of the pattern vividly depict the vitality and abundance of nature. The harmonious and cyclical cultural philosophy is reflected in the pattern's symmetry and smoothness, symbolizing the harmony of all things and perpetual movement. As a decorative motif in wax printing, this pattern is often used in clothing and textiles, fulfilling practical functions while also carrying the symbolic meaning of protection and guardianship, reflecting the people's wishes for a life of happiness and harmony with nature.
description.zh: 牡丹自唐代以来被赋予富贵、繁荣的象征意义，该纹样通过层层叠叠的花瓣，生动展现了生命力的旺盛及自然界的蓬勃生机。同时，纹样对称的构图和流畅的纹理体现了和谐与循环的文化理念，寓意万物和谐共生和永续运行。作为蜡缬工艺的装饰图案，这类纹样常用于服饰和纺织品中，在实用功能之上，还承载了保护和守护的象征意义，寄托了对生命幸福和自然和谐的祈愿。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主要意象，花心由多层小花瓣密集排列构成，呈现出饱满的层次感。外围大花瓣舒展开来，线条流畅，边缘圆润，形成自然的弧度。每一片花瓣均匀排列，整体构图对称，彰显出秩序与和谐美。装饰纹样以线刻技法表现，线条细腻且富有动感，刻画出牡丹花的生机和绽放时的动势。花形饱满，布局紧凑，展现出唐代艺术对自然形态的凝练表达。

description.en: Peony pattern symbolizes prosperity and status in Tang Dynasty culture, conveying the vitality and flourishing of life. Its symmetrical design embodies the concept of harmony, hinting at the balance between nature and life. The meticulous carving technique enhances the decorative quality of the pattern while conveying awe, aiming to protect the sanctity of the architectural space. The entire pattern embodies the cultural aspirations of Tang Dynasty people for nature, harmony, and protection of their places.
description.zh: 牡丹纹是唐代文化中富贵与繁荣的象征，其繁茂的花形传递出生命力的旺盛与欣欣向荣的愿景。纹样的对称设计体现了和谐的理念，暗示着自然与生命之间的平衡与秩序。线刻技术的精巧表现，不仅增强了纹样的装饰性，还传递了震慑的象征意义，用以守护建筑空间的安宁与神圣。整体纹样寄托了唐代人对自然生命、和谐秩序以及保护场所的文化追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为中心意象，整体呈现出对称而均衡的构图。花心由小巧的花朵组成，紧密排列，象征花的繁茂与活力。向外展开的花瓣呈尖状，形态饱满而富有张力，每片花瓣中央装饰有波状纹理，增强了纹样的层次感和动感。此外，外围以卷草纹点缀，使纹样的外轮廓柔和流畅，与内层花瓣相辅相成。整体构图注重秩序与对称，线条简练且富有韵律，体现出唐代织锦工艺的艺术讲究与精湛技法。

description.en: Peony has long been considered a symbol of prosperity and status, with this motif featuring multiple layers of petals and a full composition to vividly depict the vitality of life and the flourishing of nature. The sharp edges of the petals and the compact arrangement of the central flower symbolize harmony and cycles, conveying the philosophical concept of natural balance and coordination. Brocade, as a high-quality textile carrier, this motif not only decorates but also carries cultural significance, symbolizing the protection of homes and blessings for health, which is a true reflection of the Tang Dynasty's reverence for nature and life.
description.zh: 牡丹历来被视为富贵与繁荣的象征，该纹样通过多层花瓣的叠加与饱满的构图表现了生命的旺盛与自然世界的蓬勃生机。花瓣的尖锐形态与中心花朵的紧凑布局，寓意和谐与循环之美，传达了自然界平衡协调的哲学理念。织锦作为高端织物载体，这一纹样不仅用于装饰，还寄托了守护家宅、祈福安康的文化意义，是唐代对自然与生命崇拜的真实写照。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This floral pattern features a central rosette of peonies, with a circular motif in the center. The petals radiate outward, forming a radial arrangement. Each petal is distinctively layered, with inner petals compact and outer petals expansive, creating a sense of abundance. The petal lines are smooth and the edges are rounded, making the design visually appealing. The petals have space between them, adding depth and movement to the pattern. The overall composition emphasizes the central flowers, showcasing symmetry to achieve an ordered aesthetic, while maintaining simplicity and rhythm, reflecting the elegance of Tang dynasty porcelain designs.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为核心构图，花心以圆形点缀，周围层层花瓣向外舒展，形成放射性布局。每片花瓣层次分明，内层花瓣小巧紧凑，外层花瓣宽大饱满，构成视觉上的繁茂感。花瓣线条流畅，边缘圆润，装饰性强，花瓣间留有间隙，使纹样富有层次和动感。整体构图刻意突出中心花朵，以对称设计展现秩序之美，纹样简洁而富有节奏感，展现了唐代瓷器装饰纹样的典雅之美。

description.en: This peony pattern conveys reverence for life and nature during the Tang Dynasty, with the circular center symbolizing vitality and cyclical renewal, while the outwardly spreading petals represent the vitality of life and the flourishing of nature. The symmetrical and lush composition reflects the harmony philosophy, symbolizing the harmonious coexistence of all things and the laws of nature's movement. As a decorative motif on porcelain, these patterns not only enhance the aesthetic appeal of the vessel but also carry the meaning of awe and protection, safeguarding the vessel from external disturbances, reflecting the Tang Dynasty's cultural pursuit of purifying space and creating an aura.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹传递了唐代对于生命与自然的崇敬，花心的圆形象征生机与循环，花瓣向外舒展表现了生命的旺盛与自然界的蓬勃生机。对称而繁茂的构图反映了和谐哲学，寓意万物和谐共生与自然运行的规律。作为瓷器装饰，这类纹样既赋予器物美感，也承载了震慑与守护意义，用以保护器物不受外界侵扰，体现了唐代对于空间净化和气场营造的文化追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹为主要构图，花心呈现密集的小花形态，周围花瓣层叠展开，形成饱满而华丽的视觉效果。花瓣线条流畅，边缘弧度自然，呈现出优雅的动态感。下方加入鱼鳞状纹样和卷草纹装饰，与花瓣和花心相连，增强了整体构图的层次感与装饰性。纹样的布局对称且紧凑，注重平衡的视觉效果，使牡丹成为纹样的焦点，同时与辅纹形成和谐统一的整体。画面运用平面绘画的表现形式，线条细腻且稳重，突出唐代壁画的典雅与工艺精髓。

description.en: Peony patterns symbolize the flourishing of prosperity and vitality, with their full composition reflecting the vitality and dynamism of nature. The fish-scale patterns further reinforce the cultural significance of cycles and movement, symbolizing the continuation of life and the order of nature. Symmetrical design embodies the concept of harmony, symbolizing the balance of all things. As an important decorative element in Tang dynasty murals, these patterns not only beautify the space but also serve as a protective measure, warding off external disturbances and demonstrating the authority and grandeur of the culture.
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征富贵与生命的繁茂，其饱满的构图展现了自然的生机与活力。鱼鳞状的纹样进一步强化了循环与运行的文化意义，寓意生命的延续与自然的秩序。对称设计体现了和谐的理念，象征万物平衡的哲学思想。作为唐代壁画的重要装饰元素，这类纹样不仅具有美化空间的功能，还起到了守护环境的作用，用以震慑外界的不安力量，彰显了权威与庄严的文化内核。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony motif features a central circular arrangement of petals, radiating outward. The petals are arranged in a radial pattern, with the inner petals being smaller and more compact, while the outer petals are larger and fuller. The edges of the petals have flowing arcs, creating a dynamic, soft, and tense visual effect. The border decoration uses scrolling foliage, enhancing the overall composition's visual appeal. The entire design emphasizes symmetry and depth, creating a harmonious visual effect that reflects the refined and elegant craftsmanship of the Tang dynasty.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主体，花心以圆形花蕊为中心，排列整齐的细长花蕊向外放射，营造出生命旺盛的姿态。花瓣层层展开，内层花瓣小巧紧密，外层花瓣宽大饱满，边缘带有流动的弧线设计，呈现出柔美且富有张力的动态效果。外围装饰纹样采用卷草纹，既强调了构图的延伸感，又点缀了整体形式的装饰性。整个纹样注重对称性与层次感，使主体意象与装饰元素之间形成和谐统一的视觉效果，展现了唐代工艺的精致与优雅。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征着繁荣与生命的蓬勃，其盛开的姿态寓意自然界的生机与生命的延续。卷草纹的加入进一步体现了循环与运行的理念，表现出万物之间的和谐关系。放射状花心不仅是视觉的焦点，也传递了通灵与震慑的文化内涵，象征着神圣与威严，赋予空间一种庄重的氛围。该纹样可能用于唐代的重要器物或装饰性平面艺术，既承载美学价值，也表达了守护与权威的象征意义。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony pattern features a refined composition with scrolling foliage framing the blooming peony. The peony petals are clearly layered, with curved lines that are soft and dynamic, capturing an elegant natural imagery. The scrolling foliage creates dynamic decorative lines that connect various elements and fill the pattern space, enhancing visual continuity. The background is designed with a fine, dense dot texture, adding more decorative and depth to the pattern. The overall composition's edges are irregular, possibly integrating with the object's form, emphasizing the harmony between details and space.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样呈现精致的构图，主体以延展的卷草纹衬托盛开牡丹花的形态。牡丹花瓣层次分明，弧线柔美且富有张力，表现了优雅的自然意象。卷草纹环绕牡丹花形成动态的装饰线条，既连接了各意象元素，又填充了纹样空间，增强整体的视觉连续性。背景采用细密点状纹理设计，赋予纹样更强的装饰效果和层次感。同时，整体构图形态边缘呈不规则状，可能与器物外形结合，注重细节与空间的适配性。

description.en: Peony motif symbolizes prosperity and vitality, with its broad petals reflecting the natural abundance and vitality. Scrollwork motif symbolizes the cycle of life and movement, embodying the philosophical idea of endless renewal and harmony among all things. Pointed background textures hint at the protective and awe-inspiring cultural significance, forming an energy barrier to protect the sanctity and dignity of the space. This motif may have been used for surface decoration on Tang dynasty artifacts, enhancing their aesthetic appeal while also conveying authority and protection.
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征着富贵与生命力，其开阔的花朵体现了自然的繁茂与生机。卷草纹寓意生命的循环与运行，表达万物生生不息、和谐共存的哲学思想。点状背景纹理则暗含守护和震慑的文化意义，形成一种能量屏障，保护空间的庄严与神圣。该纹样可能用于唐代器物的表面装饰，既美化器物，又赋予器物权威与保护的象征意义。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以一朵盛开的牡丹花为中心，其花瓣呈放射状排列，层次分明，线条流畅，充分展现了花朵的优雅与饱满。周围装饰以柔美的卷草纹延展，形成了自然流动的动态效果，同时连接画面中的其他植物意象。背景以细密的点状纹理填充，丰富了视觉层次，衬托了主体的立体感。整体构图均衡且紧凑，花朵、叶片、卷草纹路的组合使画面充满生机，传递了自然之美与唐代纹样设计的精细工艺。

description.en: Peony pattern symbolizes the prosperity and vitality of life, with the blooming flowers representing the beauty of life and the vitality of nature. The scrolling foliage and dot-patterned background jointly convey the cultural meaning of cycles and movements, symbolizing the continuation of life and the harmony of nature. The combination of plant patterns not only showcases the harmonious relationship between natural elements but also subtly conveys protective and guarding meanings, creating a sense of safety and dignity through decorative patterns. This motif may be used for surface decoration on Tang dynasty artifacts, combining aesthetic value with cultural symbolism.
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征富贵与生命的繁盛，花朵绽放代表生命的美好与自然的生机。卷草纹和点状背景共同传递了循环与运行的文化意义，寓意生命的延续与自然界的和谐秩序。植物纹样的组合不仅展现了自然万物之间的和谐关系，也暗含保护和守护寓意，通过装饰性纹样为使用者营造出一种安全且庄重的氛围。该纹样可能用于唐代器物表面装饰，结合美观与文化象征功能。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This floral pattern features a central display of peonies in full bloom, with each petal layering into a curvilinear design that is smooth and dynamic, creating a sense of fullness and depth. The inner petals are adorned with fine curvilinear lines, adding texture and realism. The surrounding area is filled with intricate point-like patterns, creating a soft background that highlights the peonies' distinct outlines. The overall composition is harmonious and round, with the peonies connected to the decorative elements through flowing lines and natural layers, resulting in a unified aesthetic.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主体，花朵居于画面中央，花瓣层层叠叠，曲线流畅且富有张力，呈现出饱满的立体感。花瓣内侧以细密的弧形线条装饰，增强了层次感和真实感。牡丹周围以点状纹理精致地填充，形成轻柔的背景，突出花朵的鲜明轮廓。整体构图圆润和谐，牡丹花与装饰元素之间通过流畅的线条和自然的层次连接，展现出浑然一体的美感。

description.en: Peony pattern is renowned as the 'flower of kings', symbolizing prosperity, status, and the vitality of life. The intricate background patterns metaphorically depict the cyclical nature of the universe and the harmony of all things, conveying a wish for a flourishing life and a long-lasting path. The round and balanced composition also reflects respect for environmental harmony and cosmic order. As decorative patterns, they not only beautify objects but also convey deep cultural connotations of protection and auspiciousness.
description.zh: 牡丹纹被誉为“花中之王”，其鲜艳、繁盛的花态象征着富贵、荣华与生命的旺盛。细密的背景点纹隐喻了自然万物的生生不息以及和谐的循环，传达出对繁荣生活和长久之道的美好期盼。同时，构图的圆润与平衡感也体现了对环境和谐与宇宙秩序的敬畏与追求。作为装饰性纹样，其存在不仅装点了物品，还传递了守护与祥瑞的深厚文化内涵。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样呈心形结构，整体构图对称且均衡，内部以牡丹花与卷草纹为主要装饰元素。卷草纹自下方延展交汇，形成柔和的弧形，同时围绕盛开的牡丹花，营造出流动的视觉效果。牡丹花瓣呈现出饱满的弧线，层次分明，纤细的纹理增强了花朵的真实感。背景以细密的点状纹理填充，提升了装饰纹样的整体层次感，并突出了主纹样的立体感与精致感。

description.en: Peony flowers symbolize prosperity and status in Chinese culture, while the scrolling foliage motif represents the cycle of life and natural laws. The overall heart-shaped composition not only conveys harmony but also may symbolize protection and guardianship, signifying a warm and safe energy field. The scattered point-like textures not only serve a decorative purpose but also further convey the richness of nature and life, reflecting the Tang Dynasty's artistic pursuit of beauty and order. This motif may be used for the surface decoration of important objects to highlight status, convey blessings, and transmit cultural value.
description.zh: 牡丹花在中国文化中寓意富贵与繁荣，卷草纹则象征生命的循环与自然的运行规律。心形的整体构图除表达和谐美感外，还可能蕴含保护与守护的寓意，象征一种温暖与安全的能量场。背景的点状纹理不仅起到装饰性作用，还进一步传递了自然与生命繁盛的内涵，体现了唐代对美与秩序的艺术追求。该纹样可能用于重要器物的表面装饰，以突出身份、表达祝福并传递文化价值。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花与缠绕的枝蔓为核心意象，构图繁复而有条理。牡丹花形饱满，花瓣层叠错落，呈现出丰盈的生命力，与流动的缠枝纹形成动态的视觉对比。缠枝纹线条优雅流畅，环绕着牡丹花蔓延扩展，枝叶间点缀细致而对称的装饰纹样，展现出自然生长的秩序与和谐。背景中密集的装饰元素进一步突出主纹样的立体感与繁盛气息，使整个画面充满生命的律动与装饰性美。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹作为中国传统纹样的典范，牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，而缠枝纹则寓意生命的循环与自然的运行规律。这一纹样所传递的不仅是视觉上的华丽，更包含了对生命力的赞颂与对自然和谐发展的祈愿。枝蔓缠绕生长的结构隐喻了生命与宇宙的关联，体现了唐代文化中对自然秩序、和谐共生的哲学思考。它还蕴含守护的寓意，以美丽与繁盛的形式寄托一种精神力量，护佑使用者的平安与好运。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹为主体，配以缠绕延伸的枝条，形成连续的图案。牡丹花朵形态饱满，花瓣层次丰富，曲线柔和，展现出茂盛的生命力。缠枝纹呈流线型相互交织，与牡丹花形成紧密的结构关系，使画面既繁复又有秩序。背景纹样中枝叶交替分布，均匀的布局与画面整体的装饰性相得益彰，体现了唐代工艺中对对称与动态平衡的追求。整个纹样造型简洁而不失华美，呈现出自然与艺术融合的美感。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹象征富贵与繁荣，同时缠绕的枝条传递出生命的循环与自然运行的哲学观念。牡丹作为中国文化中的“花王”，表达了权威的视觉象征，而枝叶缠绕的结构隐喻了和谐的自然秩序与永恒的生命力。该纹样不仅是一种装饰艺术，更是唐代社会对自然生命与文化繁荣的礼赞，包含了守护与祝福的寓意，表现了对美好生活的热切追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Interlaced scroll of peony flowers with layered petals, delicate and flowing, exuding vitality. The intertwined branches form flowing visual lines that connect the flowers and leaves, creating a continuous decorative composition. The branches extend in an arc, interweaving with the flowers and leaves, creating a rhythmic effect. The interwoven branches and flowers enhance the visual depth and overall decorative effect of the pattern, highlighting the refined and orderly aesthetic of Tang Dynasty art.
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹纹样中，牡丹花朵呈现出丰满的形态，花瓣层叠细致，线条柔和流畅，展现出蓬勃的生命力。缠绕的枝条环绕牡丹花，形成流动的视觉线条，将花朵与叶片衔接在一起，构成了连续不断的装饰性构图。枝条以弧形展开，穿插于花与叶之间，形成一种韵律感，背景中的枝叶与花纹交错排列，增强了画面的层次感和整体的装饰效果。整个纹样的对称性和均衡性突出了唐代艺术的精致与有序。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹象征富贵和繁荣，而缠绕延展的枝条则寓意生命的循环与自然的运行规律。牡丹作为“花中之王”，代表了权威与尊贵，而枝条的延展则体现了人与自然的和谐共生与生命的延续。这种纹样不仅具有华美的视觉效果，更承载了人们对自然秩序的敬畏、对生命活力的歌颂以及对繁荣和永恒的美好祝福，是唐代文化和艺术哲学的集中体现。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主，花瓣线条流畅且富有层次感，呈现出饱满且富丽的形态。缠枝图案以流动的细线连接各个意象，形成连续的装饰性构图，枝蔓环绕牡丹，曲线交织，赋予画面强烈的动感与韵律。叶片呈对称分布，富有装饰性和节奏感，与花朵形成均衡的视觉关系。整体纹样以精细的线条和优雅的构图体现出唐代艺术的繁盛与秩序感，同时展现了自然生命的蓬勃与华美。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹象征着富贵与权威，同时缠绕延展的枝蔓隐喻了生命的循环与自然的运行，这种纹样通过繁复且有序的构图表达了唐代文化中的和谐与生生不息的哲学理念。牡丹作为中国文化中的“花王”，不仅体现了贵族的尊贵地位，也寄托了对自然秩序的敬畏与守护的精神内核。整个纹样传递了对繁荣与永恒的追求，彰显华丽美观的同时承载了深厚的文化寓意。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为中心，花朵层次分明，花瓣饱满，曲线柔和，整体呈现出优雅的姿态。周围的枝叶以流畅的线条环绕，枝蔓自然延展，与主花形成动态的平衡关系。幼小的含苞花蕾点缀其间，为整体构图增添生机与变化。纹样中的枝叶依序舒展，间距均匀，装饰性强，在繁复中展现清晰的秩序感，体现了唐代艺术对自然美的高度表现力。

description.en: Peony motif symbolizes prosperity and flourishing, as the 'king of flowers' in Tang culture, it expresses the authority and vitality of life. The balanced branches and leaves, as well as the buds about to bloom, convey the aesthetic philosophy of harmony with nature, while hinting at the cyclical running of natural vitality. The meaning of the motif is not only the beauty of decoration, but also deeply reflects the Tang people's profound understanding and praise of the natural order and vitality, adding depth to both culture and aesthetics.
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征富贵与繁荣，作为唐代文化中“花中之王”的意象，它表达了权威和生命的绽放。分布均衡的枝叶以及含苞待放的花蕾，传递出自然和谐的美学理念，同时暗喻自然生机在不断循环运行的哲学观念。纹样的寓意不仅是装饰的华美，更体现了唐代人对自然秩序与生命力的深刻理解与礼赞，为文化和美学增添了深厚的内涵。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为主体，花朵层次丰富，花瓣形态饱满，排列紧密且对称。纹样中枝叶设计精巧，以卷草纹为辅，线条流畅而有力，围绕着牡丹花形成聚焦的构图效果。顶部的部分呈现出尖锐的叶状结构，向上延展，增添了纹样的动感与向上的张力。同时，整体纹样具有繁复而不凌乱的装饰性，体现出唐代艺术对细节的关注以及对华美和秩序的追求。

description.en: Peony patterns symbolize prosperity and authority, as they are considered an important motif in Tang Dynasty culture and aesthetics. The blooming peony represents prosperity and flourishing, while the flowing tendrils and sharp-edged leaves symbolize the movement of life and the cycle of nature. The pattern, with its balanced composition and ornate decoration, conveys a dual cultural meaning of harmony and awe, while also paying homage to the Tang Dynasty's reverence for vitality and natural order.
description.zh: 牡丹纹蕴含了富贵与权威的象征意义，它被视为唐代文化和美学中的重要意象。盛开的牡丹寓意繁荣昌盛，而流畅缠绕的枝蔓和向上延展的尖锐叶片暗喻生命的运行与自然的循环。纹样通过平衡的构图和华丽的装饰表达了和谐与震慑的双重文化内涵，同时彰显了唐代对生命力与自然秩序的崇敬与礼赞。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以一朵盛开的牡丹花为核心，花朵层层叠叠，花瓣密集，线条圆润流畅，展现出饱满的立体感。周围的枝叶环绕主花对称分布，叶片轮廓分明，边缘呈锯齿状，增强了纹样的动感与张力。枝蔓以流畅的曲线穿插在花朵与叶片之间，形成环绕的整体构图，富有装饰性与连贯性。整体图案布局均衡，细节繁复但不杂乱，通过线条的层次感与有序排列，呈现出一种和谐的艺术美感。

description.en: Peony pattern symbolizes prosperity and reverence, with its full flower form and symmetrical arrangement conveying authority and awe. Simultaneously, the surrounding branches and the curved spread of leaves reflect the cyclical and continuous nature of natural life, expressing reverence and praise for the natural order. This pattern not only decorates but also embodies the pursuit of prosperity, harmony, and order in Tang Dynasty culture. It symbolizes the vitality of nature and life, imbuing it with strong aesthetic and spiritual symbolism.
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征富贵与尊崇，其丰满的花形和对称环绕的布局传递了权威与震慑的文化意味。同时，枝叶的环绕和曲线蔓延体现了自然生命力的循环与运行，表达了对自然秩序的崇敬与礼赞。此纹样不仅是一种装饰，更承载了唐代文化对繁荣昌盛、和谐有序的追求。它寓意着自然与生命的蓬勃力量，同时赋予了强烈的美学与精神象征。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以独立盛开的牡丹花为主体，花朵形态饱满且具有层次感，花瓣通过细腻的线条表现出曲面的优美。两侧的叶片以长而流畅的线条展开，与花朵形成对称的布局，并通过自然的曲线连接整体。花枝呈弧形生长，增强了纹样的动感与自然之美。装饰性线条简单却精致，风格以写实为基础，同时兼具装饰表现力，展现了五代时期精工细作的艺术特点。

description.en: Peony patterns in the Five Dynasties period symbolize nobility and prosperity, conveying both the authority's cultural significance and the natural cycle of life. The blooming peony represents the vitality and movement of life, while the smooth branches and leaves suggest the harmonious development of nature. As decorative elements on objects, this pattern adds to the aesthetic appeal of the item while also paying homage to nature, life, and prosperity, reflecting the profound understanding of the natural order and life philosophy during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.
description.zh: 牡丹纹在五代时期象征尊贵与繁盛，它不仅传达了权威的文化意义，还体现了生命的自然循环。盛开的牡丹代表生命的蓬勃与运行，而枝叶之流畅则暗示自然的和谐发展。该纹样作为器物装饰，既是物品美学的点缀，又承载了对自然、生命力与繁荣的礼赞，体现了五代十国时期对自然秩序与生命哲学的深刻理解。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹以盛开的牡丹花为主要意象，花朵层次分明，花瓣饱满且呈现对称之美，细节通过精细的线条表现出柔美的质感。花枝和叶片以流畅的曲线环绕花朵，并向外扩展形成优雅的构图，增强了纹样的装饰性。枝蔓部分呈现典型的卷草纹形态，线条柔和且富有韵律，同时花朵顶部的尖状设计增添了向上的动感与庄严的仪式感。整体构图紧凑而富有层次感，兼具装饰性与形式美。

description.en: Peony patterns in Liao dynasty culture symbolize authority and the prosperity of life, with the blooming flowers representing prosperity and status. The winding and natural extension of scrolling foliage reflects the vitality's cycle and movement. Smooth lines and upward compositions in the patterns convey the Liao dynasty's pursuit of harmony with nature and order, while emphasizing awe and the importance of status. This pattern not only expresses aesthetics but also symbolizes a cultural spirit, highlighting the interplay between nature, life, and authority.
description.zh: 牡丹纹在辽代文化中象征权威与生命的繁荣，花朵的盛开代表富贵与兴盛，而卷草纹的缠绕和自然延展体现了生命力的循环与运行。纹样中流畅的线条和向上的构图反映出辽代对于自然和谐及秩序的追求，同时凸显了对震慑力与尊贵身份的强调。此纹样不仅是审美的表达，更是一种文化精神的象征，传递了自然、生命与权威间的密切关系。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony pattern features a blooming peony as the main subject, with petals unfolding in layers outward, forming a circular shape with a sense of fullness. The surrounding scrolling foliage adds a sense of movement and rhythm, creating an integrated decorative composition with the central peony. The petals are depicted with simple lines, maintaining a delicate balance while emphasizing the beauty and symmetry of the form. The overall layout is balanced, with complementary decorative elements enhancing the visual appeal of the Liao dynasty goldware, showcasing its refined, concise, and textured aesthetic qualities.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主体，花瓣层层叠叠向外舒展，呈现出饱满的圆形轮廓，充满生命的张力。周围缠绕着卷草纹样，线条流畅且具有律动感，与中央花朵构成一体化的装饰构图。花瓣以简洁的线条表现，但依然细腻，强调了形式的优美与对称性。整个纹样布局均衡，装饰性元素相辅相成，展现了辽代金器纹饰精致美观、简练而富有层次感的特点。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and vitality in Liao dynasty culture, with its full petals conveying the vitality and prosperity. The scrollwork surrounding it represents the cycle and order of nature, reflecting the Liao dynasty's reverence for harmony. As a decorative motif on noble objects, peony also conveys authority and intimidation, symbolizing status and identity. It is not only an art form but also a fusion of natural and cultural imagery.
description.zh: 牡丹在辽代文化中象征富贵与生命的繁盛，其饱满的花形传递出生命力的蓬勃以及繁荣昌盛的寓意。周围的卷草纹样代表自然秩序的运行与循环，体现了辽代对和谐自然的崇尚。同时，作为高贵器物上的纹饰，牡丹纹也具备传达权威与震慑力的文化语义，是身份与地位的象征。它不仅是一种装饰艺术，更是自然与文化意象的融合体现。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony motif features a central image of blooming peonies, presenting a symmetrical and full-bodied form with rounded petals and simple lines. The petals are smooth and concise, emphasizing the fluidity of the lines. Around the peonies, scrolling foliage and leaves are scattered, forming a circular relationship with the petals, highlighting the layers and dynamic beauty of the motif. The composition is compact and balanced, with the natural lines of the foliage and leaves complementing the central peonies, creating a harmonious aesthetic. The motif uses a black and white contrast, emphasizing the clarity and strong decorative effect of the composition.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为核心意象，花朵呈现对称而饱满的形态，花瓣圆润而简洁，注重线条的流畅感。花朵周围点缀着卷草纹样和叶片，叶片舒展而有弧度，与花朵形成环绕包裹的关系，突出了纹样的层次感和动态美。整体构图紧凑而均衡，卷草纹和叶片的自然线条与中央的牡丹花相呼应，共同营造出和谐美感。纹样采用黑白对比的形式，强调了构图的鲜明和强烈的装饰效果。

description.en: Peony patterns in Liao dynasty culture symbolize prosperity, flourishing, and vitality, with their full flower shapes signifying abundance and vitality. The scrolling foliage and leafy motifs symbolize the cyclical and orderly nature of life, reflecting the Liao dynasty's reverence for harmony and order. As decorative elements on goldware, peony patterns convey both noble cultural connotations and protective symbolism, enhancing the sense of vitality while highlighting authority and status.
description.zh: 牡丹纹在辽代文化中象征富贵、繁荣和生命力的旺盛，其饱满的花形寓意着繁盛与生机。卷草纹与叶片蜿蜒环绕，象征自然生命的循环与运行，展现了辽代对自然和谐和秩序的崇尚。作为金器装饰，牡丹纹不仅传递出高贵的文化语义，还具有守护和震慑的象征意义，在表达生命力的同时彰显了权威与身份。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony pattern features a scrolling motif of peonies as the main composition. The branches and stems are depicted as flowing curves that spiral, conveying a sense of organic growth. The main motif is a peony with full petals, arranged in layers, with smooth and elegant lines that highlight the vitality. The interlaced branches and leaves are decorated with simple curves and point-like details, creating a refined and harmonious auxiliary structure. The overall layout is compact, with the interwoven branches and flowers interlocking, emphasizing rhythm and order, while maintaining both dynamism and symmetry.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以富有装饰性的缠枝纹为主要构成，枝干以流畅的曲线盘旋缠绕，呈现出有机生长的动感。主图案为具有饱满花瓣的牡丹花，花瓣层叠排列，线条优美流畅，展现出繁茂的生机。而缠绕的枝条与叶片则以简练的曲线和点状细节装饰，形成了优雅而和谐的辅助结构。该纹样整体布局紧凑，交错的枝叶与花朵相互交融，强调了节奏感和秩序感，既具有动态的生命活力，又呈现出形式的对称美与韵律美。

description.en: Interlaced scroll of peony embodies the profound cultural connotations of prosperity and endless renewal. The peony, as the 'flower of the flowers' in Chinese culture, symbolizes prosperity and nobility. The interlaced continuation of the peony motif metaphorically represents the cyclical nature of natural life and endless regeneration. The flowing lines in the pattern symbolize the movement and continuation of life, reflecting the Liao dynasty's pursuit of natural cycles and harmony. Additionally, as a decorative motif on goldware, the interlaced peony pattern conveys the symbolic representation of honor and nobility, possessing certain authority and artistic value.
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹意象蕴含着繁荣与生生不息的深厚文化内涵，牡丹作为中华文化中的“花中之王”，象征着富贵和尊荣，而缠枝的延续性则隐喻自然生命的循环和无尽再生。纹样中的线条流动象征着生命的运行与延续，展示了辽代文化对自然循环与和谐秩序的追求。此外，作为金器的装饰纹样，缠枝牡丹纹还传递了荣耀与高贵的身份象征，具有一定的权威性和艺术价值。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony pattern features a central theme of blooming peonies, presenting a symmetrical and lush form with evenly arranged petals, smooth lines flowing naturally, and vibrant vitality. The flower leaves on both sides are flowing and curved, forming a continuous composition with the flowers. The interlaced scroll at the bottom connects the flowers and leaves, with smooth, rounded lines that create a sense of rhythm and add to the overall composition's unity and decoration. The pattern is compact and layered, with a contrast of black and white, creating a strong visual impact and reflecting the elegance and delicacy of Liao dynasty art.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以盛开牡丹为核心意象，花朵呈现对称且丰满的形态，花瓣排列均匀，线条流畅自然，展现了花卉的生机与美感。左右两侧的花叶形态舒展，线条曲折柔美，与花朵形成一个环绕的构图。底部的缠枝纹以蜿蜒的曲线贯穿整个画面，连接各个花卉和叶片，线条圆润流畅，充满韵律感，并为整体构图增添了统一性和装饰性。纹样布局紧凑而富有层次感，黑白分明，给人以强烈的视觉冲击力，同时体现了辽代艺术的优雅与细腻。

description.en: Peony as a symbol of prosperity and life in Chinese traditional culture, represents the Liao dynasty's aspiration for a good life and respect for vitality. The interlaced scroll motif suggests the cyclical nature of life in nature, reflecting the enduring cultural meaning. This pattern conveys the harmony of nature and the authority of identity, while also symbolizing the respect for authority and power, as a decorative element on goldware. The interplay of natural imagery and flowing composition showcases the fusion of vitality and order in Liao dynasty culture.
description.zh: 牡丹作为中华传统文化中的富贵与繁荣象征，代表了辽代对美好生活的向往和对生命力的推崇。缠枝纹样则暗示自然界生命的循环与运行，体现了生生不息的文化意义。该纹样整体传递了和谐自然与身份尊贵的理念，同时作为金器装饰，它还隐喻权威与震慑力，表达了辽代贵族对地位和力量的追求。这种纹样通过自然意象与流动的构图，展现了辽代文化中生命力与秩序的融合。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以一朵盛开的牡丹为主体构图，花朵位于中心位置，花冠优雅开放，花瓣层层叠叠向外舒展，呈现出自然生长的韵律。花瓣线条流畅，花蕊纤细并向上延伸，形成动感十足的姿态，充满生命力。周围分布的叶片呈对称布局，以宽大的叶面与简洁的轮廓形成对比，与花朵相互呼应。整体纹样以黑白对比的形式，强调纹饰的结构与层次感，展现了辽代工艺的精巧与艺术的张力。

description.en: Peony pattern symbolizes prosperity, vitality, and harmony in Chinese culture, further emphasizing the harmonious growth of natural elements. The delicate flower stamens extend upwards, symbolizing the vitality and dynamism of life, signifying perpetual renewal and the natural movement of order. As a decorative motif on Liao dynasty goldware, this design not only highlights the owner's identity and authority but also praises the beauty of nature and life, conveying the cultural pursuit of harmony and a life of nobility.
description.zh: 牡丹纹在中国文化中被视为富贵、繁荣与生命力的象征，而该纹样中的叶片与花的组合进一步强化了自然万物和谐生长的意象。纤细的花蕊向上伸展，体现了生命的蓬勃与动态，寓意生生不息和自然的运行秩序。作为辽代金器上的装饰纹样，这一设计不仅彰显了器物主人的身份与权威，还展现了对自然之美与生命力的礼赞，传递了文化中对和谐与尊贵生活的追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony motif is circular in composition, centered by blooming peonies. Other flowers and branches are arranged around them, creating a rich and varied visual effect. The petals of peonies are full and round, with fine textures and sparse/dense relationships reflecting the natural beauty and delicacy. The interweaving of branches and leaves, with simple and smooth shapes, contrast with the flowers, giving the image a sense of movement and balance. The motif is enclosed by two concentric circles, reinforcing the overall effect and centralization, adding a sense of solemnity and decorative beauty.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样呈圆形构图，以盛开的牡丹为中心意象，周围配以其他花卉和枝叶，形成层次丰富的画面。牡丹的花瓣饱满圆润，细致的纹理与疏密关系展现了自然的柔美与精致。辅以枝叶的相互交错，枝叶形态简洁流畅，与花朵形成鲜明对比，使画面既有动感又具平衡感。纹样外部以两道同心圆边框围绕，强化了画面的整体感和集中性，赋予纹样一种庄重且装饰性的美感。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹自古以来被视为富贵与繁荣的象征，其在纹样中的运用不仅体现了宋代对美好生活的追求，更传递了生命力与自然之和谐。纹样中环绕的枝叶象征自然界万物的循环与运行，丰富的纹饰语言展现了人与自然的深刻联系。作为瓷器的装饰，该纹样不仅具有艺术审美价值，同时也寓意着身份的高贵和文化修养的深厚。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: The peony motif on this wood carving is centered with a blooming peony at the center. The petals are layered and structurally rich, conveying vitality. The branches and leaves, with flowing curves, complement the peony, creating a harmonious composition. The overall pattern is dynamic yet balanced. Below, a series of meander patterns are arranged, adding simplicity to the pattern while enhancing its structural and decorative qualities, stabilizing the visual focus below. The interwoven elements form a cohesive, balanced whole, enriching the artistic expression of Liao dynasty architecture and sculpture.
description.zh: 该木雕牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主体，花朵位于中心位置，花瓣层层叠加且结构丰满，呈现出蓬勃的生命力。两侧的枝叶以流畅的曲线环绕，与花朵形成和谐的构图，整体纹样富有动感且不失平衡。下方装饰有连续回纹图案，线条简洁，增强了纹样的结构感和装饰性，同时将画面的视觉重心稳定于下方。纹样中的各元素彼此交织，形成一个既紧密又舒展的整体，为辽代建筑和雕塑增添了精美的艺术表现。

description.en: Peony, a symbol of prosperity and status in Chinese culture, is depicted in its floral patterns as signifying authority and nobility. The intertwined branches and the continuous meander patterns symbolize the cyclical nature of the natural world, conveying the concept of perpetual renewal. As a part of Liao dynasty wood carving architectural decoration, this motif not only embodies artistic aesthetics but also conveys the spirit of protecting the architectural space, reflecting the ancient Chinese value of harmony between humans and nature.
description.zh: 牡丹作为中华传统文化中的富贵与繁荣象征，纹样中盛开的花朵寓意权威与地位的尊贵。缠绕的枝叶和连续回纹则展现了自然的循环与运行，传递生生不息的文化理念。作为辽代木雕建筑装饰的一部分，该纹样不仅体现了艺术审美，更传递了保护建筑空间的守护精神，反映了古代建筑中人与自然和谐共生的价值观。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony pattern features a single blooming peony as its main subject, with a compact and full structure of petals. The layered petals exhibit a complex decorative aesthetic. The petals are depicted through smooth lines and intricate textures, creating a visual effect of movement and softness. The pattern is arranged in a symmetrical composition, with petals overlapping in a well-ordered manner, giving the overall form a sense of rhythm. The pattern is presented in a simple black and white, highlighting the delicate texture of the decoration, showcasing the high-level craftsmanship of Song dynasty porcelain patterns.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以单朵盛开的牡丹花为主体，花朵结构紧凑饱满，层叠的花瓣呈现出繁复的装饰美感。花瓣通过流畅的线条和细密的纹理刻画，形成动感与柔美并存的视觉效果。纹样以对称的构图方式展现，花瓣之间交叠有序，使整体造型富有节奏感。纹样采用简洁的黑白呈现，突出装饰的细腻质感，展现了宋代瓷器纹饰工艺的高超水平。

description.en: Peony in Chinese culture symbolizes prosperity and status, with its full, blossoming flowers conveying the vitality of life and the cyclical nature of things. The layered design of petals conveys the harmony and cycle of growth, reflecting the profound understanding of nature and life by the Song Dynasty. As a decorative motif on porcelain, this design not only reflects the social status and taste of the object's owner but also embodies the pursuit of living standards and spiritual depth in Song society.
description.zh: 牡丹在中国文化中象征富贵与繁荣，该纹样中丰满的花朵寓意生命力的蓬勃与自然的运行。花瓣层叠的设计传递出万物生长的和谐与循环，展现了宋代对自然之美和生命意义的深刻理解。作为瓷器的装饰纹样，这种设计不仅体现了器物主人的身份与品味，也映射了宋代社会对生活品质与精神内涵的追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony interlaced scroll pattern features a bouquet of peonies arranged symmetrically, with full, balanced petals. The interlaced scroll motif is seamlessly integrated into the composition, flowing curves interweaving with leaves and petals, creating a dynamic and layered pattern. The even distribution of flowers and leaves results in a continuous decorative effect. The interwoven branches and leaves enhance the rhythmic quality of the pattern, making it more cohesive and visually appealing. The use of black and white to emphasize structure and depth highlights the intricate details of the peony interlaced scroll, showcasing the exquisite ceramic decoration techniques of the Song dynasty.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹纹样以盛开的牡丹花为主要意象，花朵饱满对称，层次分明，表现出繁华与生机。缠枝贯穿整个画面，枝条以流畅的曲线延展，并与叶片、花朵自然交织，构成充满动感和层次的整体图案。画面中花与枝叶分布均匀，形成连续性的装饰效果，而缠枝的韵律感增强了纹样的连贯性与整体感。该纹样以黑白对比强调结构和层次感，具有强烈的装饰艺术美，展现了宋代瓷器装饰工艺的精湛与典雅。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status, while the interlaced scroll of branches and leaves symbolize the continuation of life and the cycle of nature. The interwoven branches and flowers convey a harmonious relationship between humans and nature, reflecting the profound understanding of the Song Dynasty's cultural emphasis on vitality and the natural running laws. As a decorative element on porcelain, this motif not only has aesthetic value but also carries symbolic meaning, embodying the Song Dynasty's pursuit of refined lifestyles and cultural connotations.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，缠枝的延展则寓意着生命的延续与自然的循环。纹样中枝叶与花朵的缠绕传递了人与自然和谐共生的美好理念，反映了宋代文化中对生命力与自然运行规律的深刻理解。作为瓷器装饰，该纹样不仅具有审美价值，更富含象征意义，体现了宋代人对高雅生活方式和文化内涵的追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony interlaced scroll pattern features a blooming peony at the center, surrounded by symmetrically arranged flowers and leaves intertwined with branches. The petals are layered, showcasing rich depth, with smooth lines that are elegant and beautiful. Fine textures are carved on the petals, enhancing the detail. The interlaced scroll forms a closed circular composition, symbolizing cycles and the completeness of the whole. The design is compact yet dynamic, reflecting the delicate and high-level artistic skills of the Song Dynasty.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹纹样以一朵盛开的牡丹花为主体，位于中心位置，周围环绕着对称分布的花叶与缠绕的枝条。花瓣层层叠叠，呈现出丰富的立体感，线条流畅优美，花瓣表面刻有细密的纹理，进一步增强了纹样的细节感。缠枝以环状延展，形成一个圆形的闭合构图，象征着循环与整体的完整性。整体设计紧凑而又不失灵动性，表现出宋代工艺的细腻与高超艺术水平。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹一直被视为富贵、繁荣与华美的象征，而缠枝图案则具有自然循环和生生不息的寓意。纹样中呈现的和谐构图体现了人们对自然之美的崇尚与对平衡的追求。整个设计也暗含了对生命力的歌颂，象征着繁荣昌盛与万物和谐共存的理想。作为一种瓷器装饰，这一纹样不仅是艺术创作的体现，更以其美好寓意寄托了人们对于幸福生活的希望与守护。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹纹样以弧形构图展开，主体由盛开的牡丹花和蜿蜒缠绕的枝条组成。牡丹花朵层叠饱满，花瓣流畅优美，周围缠枝以柔和的曲线交织，枝叶繁茂且富有装饰性。纹样整体呈流动感强烈的环状布局，枝条穿插和连接，使各意象紧密关联。黑白色彩的对比强调了纹样的层次和细节，体现出浓厚的艺术性与宋代瓷器装饰的精湛工艺水平。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与生命的繁荣，而缠枝图案寓意生命的延续与自然的循环。纹样中缠枝的流动与花朵的盛开，传递出和谐共生的自然秩序，体现了宋代对生命力及自然运行规律的崇敬。纹样的圆形布局也喻示着无穷无尽的循环，象征着繁荣、和平以及生命的永恒。作为瓷器装饰，此纹样不仅具有装饰功能，更承载了宋代社会对美好生活及自然秩序的向往。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony interlaced scroll pattern is characterized by its simple and fluid composition, showcasing the blooming peonies intertwined with delicate scrollwork. The peony petals are full and layered, presenting a natural open flower form, while the branches extend in curves, connecting the flowers to the leaves. The interlaced lines are elegant, creating a sense of continuity and overall design. The contrast between black and white highlights the pattern's structural hierarchy and decorative elements, adding a strong visual impact, and reflecting the delicate and refined craftsmanship of the Song dynasty.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹纹样以简洁流畅的构图展现了盛开的牡丹与柔美的缠枝。牡丹花瓣饱满而富有层次感，花朵呈现自然的开放姿态，枝条以曲线延展，连接花朵与叶片。缠枝的线条优美，整体纹样呈现出连续性和整体感。黑白对比的设计突出了图案的结构层次与装饰性，并赋予纹样强烈的视觉冲击力，同时体现了宋代工艺的细腻与高雅。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status, while interlaced scrolls symbolize the continuation of life and the cyclical nature of things. The interplay of blooming flowers and winding scrolls in the pattern conveys a harmonious, peaceful order reflecting nature, life, and the cyclical nature of things. This pattern not only represents decorative art but also a cultural expression, reflecting the profound understanding and pursuit of nature, life, and harmony by the Song Dynasty people.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，而缠枝则寓意生命的延续与自然循环。纹样中花朵的盛开与缠枝的蜿蜒交织，展现了和谐美满的自然秩序，传递出生命力的蓬勃与生生不息的循环观念。该纹样不仅是一种装饰艺术，更是一种文化表达，其意蕴反映了宋代人民对自然、生命及和谐的深刻理解与追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: This peony and interlaced scroll motif features flowing curved branches and leaves as the main subject. The branches interlace and wrap around each other, creating a beautiful continuous decorative effect. The peony flowers occupy the main position, with layers of petals that are layered and full, exuding a sense of richness. The lines are soft and smooth, the stamens are delicate and refined, and the surrounding buds and symmetrical leaves are scattered. The branches naturally extend, complementing the flower shape, and the elements are closely connected, presenting a complex but not chaotic harmony. The black and white design highlights the layers of the pattern, fully demonstrating the high aesthetic standards of Song Dynasty craftsmanship in details and order.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹纹样以流动的弧线状枝蔓为主体构成，枝叶交错、环绕其中，形成优美的连续性装饰。盛开的牡丹花占据了主要位置，花瓣层层叠叠，饱满绽放，线条柔美流畅，花蕊精美细腻，周围点缀着含苞待放的花蕾与对称分布的叶片。枝蔓自然延展，与花形交相呼应，各元素之间紧密联系，呈现出一种繁复而不凌乱的和谐美感。黑白分明的设计使图案的层次更加突出，充分体现了宋代工艺审美中对细节与秩序的高度追求。

description.en: Peony has long been considered a symbol of prosperity, status, and beauty, while the interlaced scroll is a manifestation of the life cycle and harmony in traditional Chinese art. This pattern, through the depiction of blooming peonies and winding vines, conveys the principle of perpetual life and the coexistence of all things. Each petal and leaf is interrelated, expressing the harmony and prosperity of the Song Dynasty society. This pattern not only serves as an artistic decoration but also embodies cultural aesthetics and traditional values.
description.zh: 牡丹一向被视为繁荣、富贵和美丽的象征，而缠枝纹则是中国传统艺术中生命循环与自然和谐的表现形式。此纹样通过对盛开牡丹与蜿蜒枝蔓的刻画，传达了生生不息的自然规律和万物共生的理念。纹样中每一花每一叶都相互呼应，表达了宋代社会对和谐与繁荣的美好追求。这一纹样不仅是艺术装饰，更是文化审美与传统价值观的物化体现。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

description.en: The peony pattern brick carving features a circular composition with a regular meander pattern border. The central motif highlights the layers and grandeur of the main design. The peony blooms in the center, with rich and full petals, exuding a sense of liveliness and grace. The branches and leaves are natural and flowing, while the lines are smooth. The intricate details of the peony's petals contrast with the surrounding decorative patterns, showcasing the delicate craftsmanship and fine details of Song Dynasty brick carving art. The overall composition is simple and majestic, with a harmonious arrangement of elements and proportions that reflect the beauty of harmony and order.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹砖雕以圆形构图呈现，外围以规整的回纹装饰，凸显中心主体纹样的层次感与庄重感。牡丹花居中盛开，其花瓣层次丰富而饱满，形态生动优雅，枝叶自然舒展，线条流畅。花朵的细腻雕刻与周围的装饰纹样形成鲜明对比，展现宋代砖雕艺术的精巧与细节处理能力。整体构图简洁大气，意象之间的排列和比例设计充分体现了和谐与秩序美。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹自古以来象征富贵、繁荣与美好生活，而回纹的使用则进一步强化了生生不息的自然循环概念。纹样的整体凝聚力和中心化的设计传递出一种和谐的自然秩序，体现了宋代文化中对生命力与自然运行规律的深刻理解与敬畏。砖雕的用途可能与建筑装饰相关，其纹样寓意与形式将建筑的权威性与保护人的功能结合，扩展了艺术表达的意义。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

title.en: Harmonious Rhythm Peony Brick Carving Pattern

description.en: The peony pattern brick carving features a circular composition, with multiple blooming peonies and winding vines arranged within. The peony petals are clearly layered and full, with smooth and flowing lines that convey the exquisite beauty of Song Dynasty carving art. The vines interlace between the flowers, creating a natural connection and transition, resulting in a tightly structured and orderly pattern. The peony leaves, ending in soft curves, complement the overall design of the circular border, achieving a sense of balance and harmony.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹砖雕以圆形构图为基础，内部排列多个盛开的牡丹花与蜿蜒缠绕的枝蔓。牡丹花瓣层次分明、饱满丰盈，线条细腻流畅，展现出宋代雕刻艺术的精致之美。枝蔓穿插于花朵之间，形成自然的连接与过渡，使整个纹样布局紧密而有序。花纹周围的枝叶以柔和曲线收尾，与圆形边界的整体设计相呼应，展现出均衡与和谐的视觉效果。

description.en: Peony has been endowed with the meanings of prosperity and status throughout history, while the interlaced scroll symbolizes the continuation of life and the cyclical nature of the universe. This motif, combining flowers and vines, conveys the vitality of nature, while also reflecting the interweaving of life and harmony. Its circular composition not only symbolizes completeness and wholeness but may also metaphorically represent the cosmic order and the cycle of life. As a brick carving on buildings, this motif combines decorative and symbolic qualities, reflecting the profound understanding of the Song Dynasty on nature and life, as well as the protection of the home.
description.zh: 牡丹自古以来被赋予富贵、繁荣的寓意，而缠枝纹象征生命的延续与自然的循环往复。此纹样通过花朵与枝蔓的有机结合，传递出生机勃勃的自然之美，同时表现了万物交织共生、和谐运行的理念。其圆形构图不仅象征着完整与圆满，还可能隐喻宇宙的秩序与生命的循环。作为建筑砖雕，这种纹样兼具装饰性与象征意义，体现了宋代对自然与生命的深刻理解以及守护家园的追求。

sourceReference: 物像-植物_中国牡丹纹图谱（陈鲁夏）

title.en: Prosperity Interlaced Scroll Circular Peony Pattern

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该元代牡丹纹以圆形构图展现，中心盛开的牡丹花作为主意象，其大气饱满的花朵占据视觉核心，层叠的花瓣显得繁茂、生动。周围辅以其他植物纹样，如藤蔓和小花，形成流动的环状结构，与牡丹相互呼应。整体纹样线条流畅且富有装饰感，花与叶的比例和排列强调了构图的平衡性。外圈环绕简洁的装饰带，强化了圆形的整体框架，突显纹样的秩序和装饰性。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹在中国传统文化中象征富贵与生命的繁荣，而环绕的藤蔓和小花意象传递了自然的循环与运行之美。纹样的圆形结构体现了和谐与完整的理念，表达了天圆地方的宇宙观。装饰纹样还反映了元代蒙古族文化对自然意境的崇尚，融合了装饰性与实用性。此纹样既传递了权威与守护的寓意，又反映了生命力与自然秩序的延续，是器物上的艺术表达与文化象征的结合。

sourceReference: 民族_蒙古族图案（阿木尔巴图）

description.en: The peony with red, green, and blue colors has a flowing and layered overall composition. The red peony flowers, as the visual focal point, have rich layers of petals, with intricate lines decorating the edges, highlighting the flowers' beauty and abundance. The green leaves, woven into interlaced scroll structures by natural flowing curves, interconnect with the blue vines, creating dynamic decorative effects. The interweaving of peonies and leaves creates a harmonious and flourishing scene, with a clear sense of rhythm and decorative appeal, imbued with vitality while maintaining elegance.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以红、绿、蓝三色为主配色，整体构图充满流动感与层次感。盛开的红色牡丹花作为视觉焦点，花瓣层叠丰富，边缘装饰以精细线条，突显花朵的华美与繁茂。绿色叶片以自然流畅的曲线交织成缠枝结构，与蓝色藤蔓互相连接，形成动态的装饰效果。缠枝的设计让牡丹花与叶片交融，构建出和谐、繁盛的画面，整体纹样具有鲜明的节奏感与装饰性，既富有生机，又不失优雅。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status, while the interlaced scroll design embodies the continuation of life and the cycle of nature. The tri-color pattern in the motifs conveys the harmony of diversity in nature, reflecting the Chinese culture's respect for natural beauty and vitality. The interlaced design metaphorically symbolizes the movement and connection of life, embodying the philosophy of perpetual renewal, and through the lush floral patterns, it conveys a sense of protection and blessing for the vessel. As a decorative element on porcelain, it symbolizes both status and identity, as well as a respect for nature and life.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，而缠枝的设计体现生命的延续与自然的循环。纹样中三色搭配传递了自然中多样性的和谐，展现了中国传统文化对自然美与生命力的推崇。缠枝结构暗喻生命的运行与连接，表现了生生不息的哲学理念，同时通过繁茂的花叶纹样赋予器物守护与祝福的寓意。作为瓷器上的装饰图案，它既是身份与地位的象征，也寄托了对自然与生命的敬意。

sourceReference: 其他_纹饰之美：中国纹样的秘密（涂睿明）

description.en: The peony and lotus scroll pattern is characterized by its vibrant red, yellow, and green tones. The overall composition is in a vertical strip format, emphasizing the continuous and rhythmic nature of the interlaced scroll. The lotus flowers are the main motif, with full, rounded petals that flow smoothly. The contrast of red and yellow colors highlights the lush and opulent nature of the lotus. The green leaves, arranged in flowing curves, interlace with the vines, creating a dynamic interwoven structure. The bordering vertical strips serve as visual boundaries while adding to the neatness of the design, resulting in an overall balanced and decorative composition.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以鲜艳的红色、黄色和绿色为主色调，整体采用竖条式构图，表现了缠枝藤蔓的连续性与节奏感。牡丹花为主意象，花朵形态饱满，层叠的花瓣线条流畅，红、黄两种色彩交替展现其繁茂与华丽。绿色叶片以流动的曲线展开，与藤蔓环绕交织，构成缠枝的动态结构。两侧竖条纹样的装饰图案起到了边界限定作用，同时增加了设计的工整感，整个画面均衡而富有装饰性。

description.en: Peony has been a symbol of prosperity and life's flourishing throughout history, while interlaced scroll designs showcase the cyclical nature of life and the interplay of natural elements. The color combinations in the patterns enhance visual appeal while reflecting the harmonious coexistence of nature. The vine design metaphorically represents the interplay of life and the movement of elements, expressing China's traditional reverence for natural order and life's significance. This interlaced peony pattern is often used in porcelain decoration, showcasing the object's noble quality while conveying wishes for longevity and prosperity.
description.zh: 牡丹自古以来象征富贵与生命的繁荣，而缠枝设计展现了自然的循环与生命的生生不息。纹样中的色彩搭配不仅提升了视觉美感，还体现了和谐共生的自然哲学。藤蔓缠绕的设计隐喻了生命之间的运行与连接，表达了中国传统文化对自然秩序与生命意义的推崇。此缠枝牡丹纹常用于瓷器装饰，既彰显器物的高贵气质，又寄托了对长寿与繁荣的美好祝福。

sourceReference: 其他_纹饰之美：中国纹样的秘密（涂睿明）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹呈现对称式的构图，整体背景为浅蓝色，凸显出主要意象的鲜明色彩。红色、黄色、和白色的牡丹花作为主意象依次排列，花瓣层叠繁复，造型饱满圆润，体现了生命的繁茂与华丽。绿色的缠枝藤蔓穿插于牡丹之间，与深蓝色的小花相互点缀，形成视觉上的层次感与流动性。两侧边缘装饰以几何纹样和竖条设计，将画面分割为整齐的区域，强化了其严谨的构图形式，同时增添了装饰性细节。

description.en: Peony, a symbol of prosperity and life, interlaces with interlaced scroll patterns to convey the philosophical idea of cyclic natural life. The pale blue background creates an expansive space, while the green vines connect different elements, reflecting the harmony of nature. The application of geometric patterns subtly conveys the symbolic meanings of order and authority, imbuing the decorative elements with solemnity and awe. This pattern not only praises the vitality of Chinese culture but also embodies the aesthetic of art and utility in Chinese objects.
description.zh: 牡丹作为富贵与繁荣的象征，与缠枝纹样表现出自然生命的循环和生生不息的哲学理念。背景的浅蓝色营造了开阔的空间感，绿色藤蔓连接不同意象，体现出和谐共生的自然秩序。几何纹样的应用则暗含秩序与权威的象征，赋予器物装饰以庄重与震慑的品质。这一纹样不仅展现了中国传统文化对生命力的赞美，也体现了艺术与实用结合的器物美学。

sourceReference: 其他_纹饰之美：中国纹样的秘密（涂睿明）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹呈现简洁而精致的构图，花朵以线条雕刻形式表现，展现出玉器纹样的精湛工艺。牡丹花由花瓣与花心构成，花瓣层叠环绕，边缘采用流畅且均匀的曲线，形成饱满生动的形态。花瓣内部以细密的线条作为装饰，与花心的点状纹理形成对比，增强了视觉层次感。整个纹样强调了花朵的中心对称性与均衡性，凸显了玉器纹样的庄重与典雅。

description.en: Peony pattern symbolizes prosperity and authority, with its layered petals and symmetrical design reflecting the flourishing of life and harmony. The intricate texture hints at the craftsmanship of the jade object, highlighting its cultural significance as a symbol of high quality. The peony pattern on the jade object not only decorates the item but also embodies the desire of the Wu and Yue dynasties for prosperity, authority, and respect for nature. Its use on the jade object conveys the meaning of protection and blessing, making it an important symbol of status and identity.
description.zh: 牡丹纹象征富贵与权威，同时以花瓣层叠和中心对称的设计表现出自然生命的繁盛与和谐。细密的纹理暗含对器物制作工艺的追求，彰显玉器作为高贵材质的文化意义。玉器上的牡丹纹不仅是装饰图案，也体现了吴越国时期对富贵、权威的追求与对自然生命的尊崇。该纹样在玉器上的运用，表达了守护与祝福的寓意，是身份地位的重要象征。

sourceReference: 玉器_中国古代玉器纹饰图典

description.en: Main subject is peony pattern, secondary subject is the lotus pattern at the center. Peony pattern is radially arranged, surrounding the lotus, forming a balanced and symmetrical shape, showcasing the radial effect, with flowers exhibiting a sense of movement, creating a rhythmic effect.
description.zh: 主要对象是牡丹纹，次要对象是中心的莲花图案。牡丹纹呈现环状分布，围绕着中心的莲花，整体布局形成均衡且对称的形态，展现出辐射的效果，花朵有流动感，营造出节奏感。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 莲花在佛教文化中象征通灵与纯净，而牡丹则代表富贵与生命的繁荣，两者的结合不仅展现了自然的和谐美，还隐喻了生命与精神的循环运行。环状构图表现了宇宙的秩序与永恒的轮回，暗示着自然与宗教哲学的统一。这一纹样多用于建筑藻井装饰，旨在营造神圣庄严的宗教氛围，同时传递守护与富贵的文化寓意，体现了唐代对精神与人间繁荣的追求。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: This phoenix and peony design features a central peony with layers of petals that are full and rich, showcasing fine texture. The peony bears the inscription "Zhenhua" (meaning "harmony"), adding to the unique meaning of the pattern. Below the peony is a graceful phoenix with its wings spread, its tail feathers gracefully curved, connected to the scrolling foliage. The scrolling foliage has smooth, delicate lines that complement the curves of the petals and feathers, creating a sense of natural flow. The juxtaposition of the peony's grandeur and the phoenix's gracefulness results in a harmonious contrast of "motion" and "stillness," enhancing the visual depth and appeal of the composition.
description.zh: 该凤穿牡丹纹以中央的硕大牡丹花为主体，花朵层叠饱满，花瓣纹理细腻，展现出富丽堂皇的质感。牡丹花上镌刻“政和”二字，增添了纹样的独特意义。花朵下方是一只姿态优雅的凤鸟，展翅飞翔，尾羽优美地弯曲，与周围的卷草相连。卷草纹样线条流畅，细腻柔和，与花瓣和羽毛的曲线相呼应，整体构图呈现自然流动的韵律感。牡丹的稳重大气与凤凰的灵动结合，形成了“动”与“静”的和谐对比，增强了画面的层次感与视觉吸引力。

description.en: Peony in Chinese culture symbolizes prosperity and flourishing, while the phoenix is a symbol of auspiciousness, protection, and nobility. Together, they convey a desire for a good life and high status, as well as the integration of natural vitality and spiritual communication. The inscription "Zhisuo" on the carving indicates the historical context, while the motif conveys the authority of the time. The overall composition, with its balanced layout and flowing scrolling foliage, embodies the harmony of nature and the flourishing of life, reflecting the exquisite artistry and profound cultural depth of the Song Dynasty.
description.zh: 牡丹在中国传统文化中象征富贵与繁荣，而凤凰则是吉祥、守护和高贵的象征。二者结合不仅传递了对美好生活和高贵地位的追求，也将自然的生机与神话的通灵结合在一起。雕刻上“政和”二字表明了时代的背景，同时赋予纹样权威的象征意义。整体纹样通过均衡的布局与流动的卷草，体现了自然界的和谐与生命的繁盛，展现了宋代精美艺术与深厚文化内涵的统一。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: The peony and interlaced scroll pattern features a vibrant interlaced scroll of peonies, showcasing a staggered composition. The red, blue, and green peonies alternate in distribution, with their petals layered and dense, while the edges are outlined with fine gold lines, adding depth and decorative appeal. The branches and leaves wind and interlace, connecting the flowers into a flowing pattern. The interlaced scroll motif is delicate and smooth, with a sense of rhythm, complementing the layered peonies. The overall composition is both rich and harmonious, with a sense of symmetry and balance.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以绚丽的牡丹花为主要意象，呈现出错落有致的构图。红、蓝、绿三色的牡丹花交替分布，其花瓣层叠丰满，边缘采用细密的金线勾勒，增添了立体感与装饰性。枝叶蜿蜒缠绕，将各个花朵连接在一起，形成流畅的图案结构。缠枝纹样细腻优美，线条柔和且富有节奏感，与层次分明的牡丹花共同营造出繁茂而和谐的视觉效果。整体构图既饱满华丽，又具有对称平衡的韵律感。

description.en: Peony, a symbol of prosperity and life, interlaces with the interlaced scroll motif to express the continuation of life and the cyclical nature of the universe. The rich colors and gold embroidery highlight the exquisite craftsmanship of Ming dynasty brocade, while also conveying the symbolic meanings of authority and wealth. The fluidity of the scroll pattern suggests the harmony and perpetual cycle of nature, symbolizing blessings of prosperity, proliferation, and eternity. The overall composition, with its full composition and intricate details, reflects the profound understanding of Ming dynasty artists of the vitality, natural order, and decorative arts.
description.zh: 牡丹作为富贵与繁荣的象征，与缠枝图案的紧密结合表现了生命的延续与自然的循环。丰富的色彩与金线装饰展现了明代织锦工艺的精湛，同时也体现出权威与财富的象征意义。缠枝纹样的流动性暗示着自然界的和谐美与生生不息的循环，寓意着吉祥、繁衍与永恒的祝福。整体纹样通过饱满的构图与精致的细节传递了明代对生命力、自然秩序与装饰艺术的深刻理解。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: This peony interlaced scroll design features a central theme of red peonies with layers of petals that bloom. The composition exudes a sense of depth and richness. The interlaced scroll motif connects the peonies seamlessly, creating a flowing visual effect. The interlaced lines are smooth and rhythmic, contributing to the overall aesthetic. The interplay of peonies with other smaller flowers and decorative elements balances the composition, enhancing the decorative quality. The background is dark, contrasting with the vibrant colors of the peonies and the gold lines, resulting in a harmonious, structured visual effect.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以红色牡丹花为主要意象，花瓣层层盛开，展现出饱满的立体感和华丽的装饰效果。牡丹花之间通过蜿蜒的缠枝纹样自然连结，缠枝线条流畅且富有韵律感，形成了视觉上的循环流动。花与枝之间以其他小花朵与细节性图案填充，平衡了构图的空间感，增强了装饰性。背景以深色衬托，凸显了纹样的明艳色彩与金线勾勒细节，整体布局繁茂而均匀，富有层次和秩序美感。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status, while interlaced scrolls express the continuation of life and the cyclical nature of things. Together, they embody the longing for perpetual renewal and harmony with nature. The use of gold threads in brocade not only adds visual impact but also metaphorically represents authority and high status. The interwoven patterns convey the philosophical concepts of movement and cycles, reflecting the Ming Dynasty's profound understanding of natural laws and vitality. The overall design through colors, forms, and composition conveys auspiciousness and prosperity, while showcasing the exquisite craftsmanship of brocade.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，而缠枝表达了生命延续与自然的循环，二者结合体现了对生生不息的向往与自然和谐的赞美。织锦中金线的使用不仅增添了视觉震慑力，也隐喻了权威与高贵的地位。纹样的缠绕与流动传递了运行与循环的哲学观念，表现了明代对于自然规律与生命力的深刻理解。整体图案通过色彩、形态与构图传递了吉祥与繁荣的文化寓意，同时展现了织锦工艺的精湛技艺。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以华丽的牡丹花与蜿蜒缠绕的枝叶为主要构成，展现出繁茂而精致的画面。牡丹花以黄色、蓝色和橙色为主色调，花朵形态饱满，层叠的花瓣线条流畅且富有装饰性。缠枝纹样穿梭于花朵之间，以曲折优美的线条连接各个意象，形成了流动与平衡的整体布局。背景采用深色衬托，凸显了鲜艳的花朵颜色与金线勾边细节，整体视觉效果和谐而夺目，展现了明代织锦工艺的华丽特色。

description.en: Peony, a symbol of prosperity and life, combines with interlaced scroll patterns to convey the concepts of continuation and natural cycles. The fluidity of the interlaced scroll conveys the philosophical ideas of movement and perpetual renewal, while the contrast of colors enhances the visual impact and the cultural weight. The exquisite details of brocade reflect the authority's symbol, while also praising the harmony with nature and the vitality. The overall pattern showcases Ming Dynasty's high pursuit of decorative art and cultural ambiance, achieving a perfect fusion of prosperity and nature.
description.zh: 牡丹作为富贵与繁荣的象征，与缠枝纹样结合寓意生命的延续与自然的循环。缠枝纹的流动性传递了运行与生生不息的哲学思想，而色彩的对比则强化了视觉震慑力与高贵的文化符号。织锦工艺的精湛细节不仅反映了权威的象征，也表达了对自然和谐与生命力的赞美。整体纹样展现了明代对装饰艺术与文化意境的高度追求，体现了富贵与自然之间的完美融合。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: This peony motif features a central peony with layered petals, exuding a graceful and luxurious appearance. The surrounding leaves form a circular pattern around the central peony, with smooth, natural leaf lines. The contrast of the petals and leaves creates visual depth. The overall composition is characterized by a strong contrast of golden yellow and deep green, with fine detailing in gold adding a decorative touch and depth. The peony is centered, while the surrounding branches are arranged in an orderly manner, resulting in a harmonious and elegant aesthetic, as well as a sense of solemnity and order.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹纹样以画面中心的牡丹花为主要意象，花瓣层叠饱满，展现出优雅而华丽的形态。周围的叶子成环状环绕着中心花朵，叶片线条流畅，形状自然，与花瓣形成视觉上的层次对比。整体呈现出金黄色与深绿色的强烈色彩对比，并以金黄色的细致勾勒增添了装饰感与立体感。牡丹居中布局，四周的枝叶有序排列，构图集中且凝聚，展现出一种优雅的和谐美感，同时给人以视觉上的庄重感与秩序感。

description.en: Peony in Chinese culture symbolizes prosperity and harmony, with its central placement emphasizing its authority and nobility. The use of golden color further highlights the opulence of the theme, while the deep green background echoes the flourishing of nature and harmony. The interwoven branches and leaves create a cycle of life, symbolizing the continuation of life and the harmony of nature. The overall pattern conveys the grandeur and elegance of Ming dynasty brocade art, reflecting the pursuit of prosperity, nature, and harmony.
description.zh: 牡丹在中国传统文化中象征富贵与繁荣，居中的构图强化了其权威与高贵的气质。金黄色的配色进一步彰显了富丽堂皇的主题，同时深绿色的背景呼应了自然生命的繁茂与和谐。枝叶的环绕织成一种生生不息的循环意象，寓意生命的延续与自然和谐的哲学思想。整体纹样呈现出的庄重与优雅体现了明代织锦艺术的装饰价值，表达了对富贵、自然及和谐社会的追求。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: This peony and chrysanthemum pattern centers on the peony motif, with the petals layered and full, presenting a rich and beautiful form. The secondary motif is the chrysanthemum, with the petals flat and arranged radially, forming a symmetrical and balanced arrangement with the peony. The peony and chrysanthemum are connected by fine scrolling foliage, with the foliage lines flowing smoothly, creating a connection between the visual elements of the pattern, enhancing the overall decorative and dynamic sense. The pattern is predominantly in black and white, with the black flowers contrasting sharply with the white background, showcasing strong gradations and visual impact, resulting in an overall balanced and harmonious composition.
description.zh: 该菊花牡丹纹以牡丹为中心意象，花瓣层叠饱满，呈现出华丽而丰富的形态。次要意象为四周的菊花，花瓣平展，呈放射状布局，与中心牡丹形成对称而均衡的排列。牡丹与菊花之间通过细腻的卷草纹相连接，卷草纹线条流畅，形成了画面意象之间的联系，增强了整体的装饰性与动态感。纹样以黑白色为主色调，黑色的花朵与白色背景形成强烈对比，展现出鲜明的层次感与视觉冲击力，整体构图均衡而和谐。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status, chrysanthemum represents purity and longevity. The combination of these motifs expresses vitality and harmony. The scrolling foliage connects the motifs, imbuing the pattern with dynamism and a sense of movement. The contrast of black and white highlights the pattern's solemnity and power, while also reflecting the Ming dynasty's high pursuit of decorative artistry and cultural symbolism. The overall pattern praises nature and life, and expresses aspirations for prosperity and longevity.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，菊花寓意高洁与长寿，二者的结合表达了生机勃勃与优雅高尚的文化内涵。卷草纹连接不同意象，赋予纹样生命力与运行的动态感，表现了自然循环与和谐的哲学思想。黑白对比凸显了纹样的庄重与震慑力，同时体现了明代织锦艺术中对装饰性与文化寓意的高度追求。整体纹样展现了对自然与生命的礼赞及对富贵、长寿的向往。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: This phoenix and peony pattern features the phoenix as the central motif, with the phoenix spreading its wings and its feathers flowing smoothly and intricately. The overall form is elegant and lively. The surrounding peonies are arranged in a dense manner, with distinct layers, giving a sense of depth. The pattern is dominated by a golden yellow hue, with a deep red background, creating a strong contrast in colors, highlighting the opulence and grandeur of the pattern. The phoenix and peonies are connected by flowing interlaced scroll patterns, which are soft and rhythmic, contributing to a harmonious and flowing visual effect, showcasing the intricate craftsmanship and decorative nature of Qing dynasty brocade patterns.
description.zh: 该凤穿牡丹纹以中心的凤纹为主要意象，凤凰展翅飞翔，羽毛线条流畅细腻，整体形态优雅而生动。凤纹周围分布着饱满的牡丹纹，花瓣层次分明，充满立体感，与凤凰形成主次分明的对比。整体纹样以金黄色为主色调，背景为深红色，营造出强烈的色彩对比，突显纹样的华丽庄重。凤与牡丹之间通过流畅的缠枝纹相连，缠枝纹线条柔美、富有韵律，使整个构图呈现出和谐而流动的美感，展现了清代织锦纹样的精致工艺与装饰性。

description.en: Phoenix and peony have long symbolized auspiciousness and authority, signifying nobility and good fortune. The phoenix and peony together express reverence for the monarchy and prosperity, reflecting the Qing court's pursuit of authority and opulence. The interlaced scroll motif symbolizes the continuation of life and the cyclical nature of nature, creating a dynamic connection between phoenix and peony, signifying the eternal cycle of life. The overall design is sumptuous and harmonious, conveying the desire for nature, life, and a better future.
description.zh: 凤凰自古以来象征祥瑞与权威，寓意高贵与吉祥，而牡丹则是富贵繁华的象征。凤凰与牡丹的结合表达了对皇权与繁荣的礼赞，体现了清代宫廷文化中追求权威与富丽的价值观。缠枝纹象征生命的延续与自然的循环，使凤凰与牡丹之间形成动态的生命连接，寓意生生不息的自然哲学。整体纹样华贵而和谐，传递出对自然、生命与美好未来的向往。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹凤凰纹以凤凰为主要意象，位于画面底部，形态优雅，羽毛排列细腻，展现出跃起向上的动态感。次要意象为上方的牡丹纹，花朵饱满，颜色明亮，与凤凰形成上下呼应的关系。各意象间通过缠枝纹相连，线条流畅且富有装饰性，使整体纹样更加生动与协调。背景为黑色，衬托出白色与浅蓝色的凤凰与牡丹，使画面层次分明，装饰效果强烈。整体构图均衡，凤凰的动感与牡丹的静美结合，展现出动静相宜、繁复华丽的图案特点。

description.en: Phoenix in Chinese culture symbolizes auspiciousness and authority, representing nobility and protection. Peony symbolizes prosperity and flourishing. The combination of phoenix and peony creates a beautiful auspicious image, reflecting the pursuit of noble virtues and flourishing life. The interlaced scroll motif symbolizes the continuation of life and the cyclical nature of nature, presenting a philosophical idea of natural life and vitality. The contrast of the black background with the bright patterns adds a sense of awe, conveying a sense of grandeur and mystery.
description.zh: 凤凰在中国传统文化中象征祥瑞与权威，代表高贵与守护之意，牡丹则寓意富贵与繁荣。凤凰与牡丹的组合构成了一幅美好的吉祥画面，表达了对高尚品德与繁盛生活的追求。缠枝纹的流动性寓意生命的延续与自然的循环，整体纹样展现了自然生命、生机盎然的哲学思想，同时彰显了清代缎织工艺的华丽美感。黑色背景与明亮图案的对比，则赋予纹样震慑力，传递了庄严与神秘的视觉效果。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

title.en: Peony, Phoenix, and Interlaced Scroll Pattern

description.en: This peony and brocade pattern features peonies as the primary visual element, with a rich array of colors and layers. The pattern is arranged in a symmetrical manner, creating a sense of rhythm and visual harmony. The interlaced scroll adds intricate details to the flowers, connecting them seamlessly, while the background further highlights the peonies' vibrancy. The black background of the pattern highlights the vivid colors of the peonies and the brocade, creating a sense of depth and richness, showcasing the exquisite details of brocade art.
description.zh: 该缠枝牡丹纹以牡丹花作为主要视觉元素，花朵层次丰富，色彩鲜艳，呈现出饱满华丽的形态。红色与绿色的牡丹花交替排列，布局整齐且对称，营造出节奏感与视觉统一性。次要元素为缠枝纹，其细腻的线条在花朵之间延展，将各花朵有机地连接起来，作为背景进一步衬托牡丹的绚丽与生动。整体图案以黑色为底色，使色彩鲜明的牡丹花与缠枝纹更显突出，画面具有强烈的层次感，展现出织锦艺术的精美与装饰性。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status in Chinese culture, while interlaced scroll motifs symbolize the continuation of life and the cyclical nature of the universe. The interplay of red and green colors conveys the vitality of life and the diversity of nature, while the interlacing of the scroll motif embodies the harmony and vitality of the philosophical concept. The black background highlights the solemnity and awe-inspiring nature of the pattern, while the overall design not only showcases the beauty of Ming dynasty brocade but also praises prosperity, goodness, and vitality. The entire pattern integrates natural imagery with exquisite craftsmanship, making it a masterpiece of Ming dynasty brocade art.
description.zh: 牡丹在中国传统文化中象征富贵与繁荣，而缠枝纹则寓意生命的延续与自然的循环。红绿相间的配色传递了生命的活力与自然的多样性，同时缠枝纹的延展体现了和谐与生机勃勃的哲学内涵。黑色背景凸显出图案的庄重与震慑力，整体纹样不仅展现了明代织锦工艺的华美，还表达了对富贵、美好与生命力的礼赞。整个纹样融合了自然意象与精致工艺，是明代织锦艺术的典范。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: This textile embroidery featuring peony flowers primarily depicts the flowers in full bloom, with a vibrant palette of yellow and red. The arrangement of the peonies is neat and orderly, creating a sense of rhythmic progression, which is complemented by the small red flowers and green leaves. The background is predominantly dark, highlighting the vibrant colors of the flowers and leaves, enhancing the visual impact of the entire composition. The intricate interweaving of the peony flowers with the delicate leaf patterns adds to the overall harmony and complexity of the design.
description.zh: 该牡丹纹织绣以牡丹花为主要意象，花朵形态饱满，色彩鲜艳，黄与红的搭配突显了花朵的华丽与生动。牡丹花布局整齐有序，呈现出连续排列的节奏感，与红色小花和绿色叶子相结合，形成了富有层次感的装饰效果。背景以深色为主，衬托出花朵和叶片的鲜艳色彩，使整体画面更具视觉冲击力。花朵之间通过细腻的枝叶装饰纹相互连结，增加了图案的整体性与和谐感。

description.en: Peony in Chinese culture symbolizes prosperity, flourishing, and vitality, with its vibrant colors and full forms reflecting the vitality of life and the splendor of nature. The flowers are arranged in neat rows, symbolizing prosperity and order, while the connection of branches and leaves embodies the cycle of nature and harmony. The deep tones in the background give the pattern a sense of stability and solemnity, highlighting the exquisite craftsmanship of Qing dynasty embroidery. The overall pattern praises the beauty of nature and vitality, expressing the pursuit of prosperity and harmony in traditional culture.
description.zh: 牡丹在中国传统文化中象征富贵、繁荣与生命力，鲜艳的色彩与饱满的形态表现了生命的生机与自然的绚丽。花朵整齐排列，寓意繁荣与秩序，枝叶的连接体现了自然的循环与和谐。背景的深色调赋予图案稳重与庄严的视觉效果，同时凸显了清代织绣工艺的精美细腻。整体纹样展现出对自然美与生命力的礼赞，也表达了传统文化中对富贵祥和的追求。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹织绣以牡丹花为主要视觉元素，花朵形态饱满，层次感丰富，采用红黄搭配的艳丽色彩，突显了花朵的华美与生动。每朵牡丹间均匀分布绿色叶片与其他小花，蝴蝶形象点缀其中，为画面增添了灵动气息。背景以蓝色为主，与鲜艳的花朵形成强烈的色彩对比，烘托出图案的鲜明层次与装饰效果。整体构图均衡，花朵排列整齐而不失变化，枝叶纹理流畅，使画面呈现出一种自然与秩序相融合的美感。

description.en: Peony has long been a symbol of prosperity and status in Chinese culture, with its red and yellow colors further emphasizing this meaning. The green foliage and blue background symbolize the tranquility of nature and the vitality of life, while the appearance of the butterfly conveys profound meanings of spiritual communication and life transformation. The entire pattern, through the combination of flowers, foliage, and butterflies, portrays the harmony of nature and life, and also embodies the cultural connotations of prosperity, good fortune, and vitality. This pattern is an artistic masterpiece of Qing dynasty embroidery and conveys a pursuit of a beautiful life and the philosophy of nature.
description.zh: 牡丹历来是中国传统文化中富贵与繁荣的象征，红黄配色进一步强化了这种寓意。绿色枝叶与蓝色背景象征自然的恬静与生命的活力，蝴蝶的出现则传递了通灵与生命转化的深刻含义。整幅纹样通过花朵、枝叶和蝴蝶的搭配，表现了自然之美与生命的和谐共存，也彰显了富贵吉祥与热烈生命力的文化内涵。该纹样既是清代织绣工艺的艺术佳作，又传递了对生活美好与自然哲学的追求。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该牡丹纹织绣以牡丹花为主要意象，花朵形态饱满，层次感强，呈现出优雅的红白配色，象征华丽与高贵。牡丹花以有序的间隔排列，通过自然弯曲的枝蔓连接，构成连贯的装饰效果。绿色叶片衬托花朵的鲜艳，枝蔓的流动性使图案更具动感与自然气息。深色背景赋予整体纹样强烈的视觉对比，突显牡丹的繁美，同时使装饰纹样更加精致协调。整体构图平衡有序，结合自然元素与装饰性艺术，形成了典雅的设计风格。

description.en: Peony pattern symbolizes prosperity and flourishing in Chinese culture, with the pairing of red and white peonies signifying harmony and happiness. The natural extension of the branches portrays the cycle and continuity of life. The green leaves and dark background convey the tranquility and vitality of nature, imbuing the pattern with profound life force. This pattern not only praises the harmony and beauty of nature but also reflects the traditional Chinese aspiration for vitality and prosperity. It also combines with the exquisite craftsmanship of Qing dynasty weaving, highlighting the harmonious integration of art and life.
description.zh: 牡丹纹在中国传统文化中象征富贵与繁荣，红白牡丹的搭配寓意和谐与美满，枝蔓的自然延展则表现了生命的循环与延续。绿色叶片与深色背景展现了自然的静谧与生机，赋予纹样以深厚的生命力内涵。该纹样不仅传递了对自然和谐美的礼赞，还展现了传统文化对生命力和繁华的向往，同时结合清代织绣工艺精湛技法，体现了艺术与生活的高雅结合。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: This double phoenix playing peonies design features peonies centered at the heart, with vibrant colors and a grand visual effect. Two symmetrical phoenixes flank the peonies on either side, with graceful movements, as if they are playing with the flowers. This creates a lively interaction. The background is filled with intricate four-petaled flowers and wave patterns, enhancing the decorative effect and visual depth. The balanced composition and rhythmic pattern of the flowers and phoenixes make the scene lively, with a strong contrast between the vivid red and the dark background, further enhancing the decorative and visual impact of the motif.
description.zh: 该双鹤戏牡丹纹以牡丹花居于中心，牡丹花朵盛开，色彩鲜艳，呈现出雍容华贵的视觉效果。两只对称的双鹤分列花朵两侧，姿态灵动，仿佛正戏弄花朵，构成了一种生动的互动关系。背景布满细致的四瓣花及曲线纹样，形成层次丰富的装饰效果，并在视觉上突显了主体图案的饱满感。整体构图平衡而富有节奏感，花朵与双鹤的动态布局使画面充满生命力，鲜明的红色与深色背景形成强烈对比，进一步增强了纹样的装饰性和视觉冲击力。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and longevity, while the pair of swans symbolize longevity and elegance. Together, they convey the idea of a life of abundance, longevity, harmony, and happiness. The dynamic depiction of the swans playing with flowers highlights the harmony between humans and nature, while also symbolizing the cyclical nature of life and the natural world. The four-petaled flowers and the curvilinear patterns not only add decorative appeal to the textile but also reflect the respect and love for nature in the Miao ethnic culture. This intricate pattern, created through Miao embroidery techniques, embodies the Miao ethnic culture's unique aesthetic sense and the pursuit of a happy life.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，双鹤则是长寿与高雅的象征，两者结合寓意生活富足、健康长寿、美满和谐。双鹤戏花的动态表现，强调人与自然和谐共处的理念，同时隐喻生命的生生不息与自然的循环。背景的四瓣花和曲线纹样不仅增添了纹样装饰性，也呼应了苗族文化中对自然万物的崇敬与热爱。这种精美的纹样通过苗锦织绣技艺体现了苗族文化的独特审美和对幸福生活的追求。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 三经牡丹罗纹图以牡丹花为主要视觉元素，花朵形态饱满且层次分明，呈现出生命的繁茂与自然的优雅。花朵之间通过弯曲流畅的枝蔓连接，形成有机的构图，枝蔓的延展增强了画面的动态感和空间感。叶片与花朵搭配得当，整体纹样呈现出对称和韵律之美。此外，花罗织法的精巧细腻，通过三根经丝的绞转，使纹样具有独特的浮雕式层次感，展现了起平纹花、斜纹花和隐纹花等多种变化。纹样极具装饰性，强调了视觉的繁复和整体的和谐美。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status, while its branches extending and connecting symbolize the cyclical and continuous nature of harmony and vitality. The overall pattern praises the harmony and vitality of Chinese culture. The complexity of the roving technique and the exquisite design of the patterns demonstrate high-level craftsmanship and cultural taste, conveying the pursuit of harmony and prosperity. The three-thread twisting design is not only a weaving technique but also metaphorically represents the laws of the universe and the cyclical patterns. The overall pattern embodies the perfect fusion of nature and culture, and also showcases the profound cultural connotations of traditional Chinese craftsmanship.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，而枝蔓的延展与连接寓意自然生命的循环与延续，整体纹样表达了中国传统文化中对自然和生命力的礼赞。罗织工艺的复杂性以及纹样的精美设计，彰显了高超的手工技艺与文化品位，同时传递出对和谐秩序与生命繁盛的追求。三经绞转的设计不仅是一种织造技术，更隐喻了宇宙万物的运行与循环规律。整体图案体现了自然与文化的完美融合，也展现了中国传统工艺的深厚文化内涵。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

place.en: Fuzhou suburb of the northern outskirts of Fuzhou, Mount Huang Sheng tomb
place.zh: 福州北郊浮仓山黄升墓

description.en: Peony, Camellia, Honeysuckle, and Orchid pattern ingeniously combines various flowers into a single motif. Each flower is depicted in a natural and realistic manner, with dynamic poses. The layers and details of the flowers are meticulously and richly portrayed. The interwoven branches connect the flowers, creating an organic and continuous visual relationship. The fluidity of the branches gives the pattern a dynamic feel, while the alternating arrangement of different flowers adds variety and rhythm. This decorative pattern showcases the innovative design of Song dynasty textile, balancing complexity and harmony, with emphasis on both the intricacy of the details and the overall coherence.
description.zh: 茶花牡丹凌霄芙蓉纹巧妙地将多种花卉组合在一个纹样中，包括牡丹、茶花、凌霄和芙蓉。每种花卉形态自然写实，姿态生动，花朵的层次与细节表现细腻而丰富。各花卉之间通过枝蔓穿插连接，构成了有机且连贯的画面关系，整体布局自然和谐。枝蔓的流动性赋予纹样动态感，而不同花卉的交替排列使图案充满变化和节奏感。这种装饰纹样呈现了宋代染织品上的创新设计，在视觉上既繁复又均衡，构图中既注重局部的精致，又兼顾整体的连贯性。
