description.en: The floral patterns feature various flowers with unique symbolic meanings in Chinese culture: peonies symbolize prosperity and status, camellias represent resilience and purity, and peonies symbolize prosperity and status. The combination of these flowers not only highlights the diversity of nature and vitality but also expresses the pursuit of life's flourishing and harmony. The interwoven branches metaphorically symbolize the cycle of life and the coexistence of all things. The overall pattern embodies the respect for natural beauty and vitality in Song Dynasty textile craftsmanship, while deeply reflecting the profound understanding of cultural aesthetics in harmony, nature, and life.
description.zh: 纹样中的多种花卉均在中国传统文化中具有独特的象征意义：牡丹象征富贵与华丽，茶花寓意坚韧与高洁，凌霄代表升腾的精神，芙蓉则象征纯洁与美好。这些花卉的组合不仅展现了自然界的多样性与生机，也表现了对生命繁盛与和谐的追求。枝蔓的有机穿插则暗喻生命的循环延续与万物共生的哲理。整体纹样体现了宋代染织工艺对自然之美的尊崇和对生命力的礼赞，同时彰显了文化审美中对和谐、自然与生命意义的深刻理解。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

title.en: Camellia Peony Trumpet Vine Hibiscus Pattern

place.en: Fuzhou Southern Song Huang Sheng tomb

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹芙蓉五瓣花纹以 "S" 形花茎贯穿全幅，形成流动式构图，枝蔓的曲线赋予纹样自然的韵律感。花茎上的两朵主花分别呈现上扬和低垂的姿态，相互呼应，展现出动态的平衡与生动的情趣。五瓣小花作为点缀，均匀散布于枝蔓间，形成大小块面的对比，增强了画面的层次感与丰富性。整体纹样设计写实且富于变化，强调花朵自然的形态和枝蔓的延展，使装饰效果既繁复又清晰。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and status, while lotus flowers symbolize beauty and purity. The five-petaled flowers further emphasize the diversity of nature and harmony. The "S" shape interwoven design on the branches metaphorically represents the cycle of life and the laws of nature's movement. The dynamic posture of the main flowers showcases the diversity and liveliness of life. The overall pattern not only embodies the reverence and realistic depiction of natural imagery in Song dynasty embroidery, but also conveys the cultural pursuit of harmony and vitality. The handling of the size and dynamic relationship of flowers in the design reveals the intricate design philosophy and profound cultural connotations of Song dynasty weaving art.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵与繁荣，芙蓉寓意美好与纯洁，而五瓣小花则进一步表现自然界的多样性与和谐。枝蔓的 "S" 形穿插设计暗喻生命的循环与自然运行的规律，主花的动态姿态展现了生命的多样性与灵动之美。整体图案不仅体现了宋代织绣工艺对于自然意象的尊崇与写实表达，也传递了对和谐共生与生命力旺盛的文化追求。纹样设计中对花卉大小和动态关系的处理，揭示了宋代染织艺术中精巧的设计理念与深刻的文化内涵。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 如意牡丹纹以牡丹花形变化为如意造型，形成饱满的装饰性意象，并通过枝干串联，构成四方连续的图案。纹样中的花形饱满而生动，枝条曲线优美，穿插有序，整体布局匀称而富有层次感。块面设计疏密有致，既保留了图案的装饰性，又赋予画面空间感。枝干和如意形状的结合使纹样具有流动性和韵律感，强化了视觉上的动态平衡。黑白对比进一步突出了图案的装饰美感，同时强化了其富丽堂皇的整体气质。

description.en: Peony in Chinese culture symbolizes prosperity and flourishing, while the Ruyi shape represents blessings and good wishes. Together, they symbolize a life of abundance and peace. The design of intertwined branches symbolizes the cycle of life and continuity, while the repeated Ruyi shape forms a symmetrical pattern in the four directions, symbolizing the continuation and eternity of blessings. The overall pattern not only expresses respect for the beauty of nature, but also conveys a pursuit of vitality and harmony. This design fully demonstrates the innovative nature and cultural depth of Ming dynasty silk decorative patterns, showcasing both the intricacy of decorative art and profound cultural meanings.
description.zh: 牡丹在中国传统文化中象征富贵与繁荣，而如意形态则代表吉祥与美好的祝愿，两者结合寓意生活的富足和平安。枝干串联的设计象征生命的循环与持续，如意形态的重复构成四方连续图案，暗喻吉祥如意的延绵与永恒。整体纹样不仅体现了对自然界美好意象的尊崇，也传递了对生命力和和谐美满的追求。这种设计充分展示了明代丝绸装饰纹样的创新性与文化内涵，既表现了装饰艺术的精致，又融入深刻的文化寓意。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Main subject: Peony flowers with full and distinct petals arranged in neat rows. Secondary subject: Fine, long branches and leaves with curvilinear flow. Branches and leaves are arranged in a curvilinear pattern, connecting flowers and forming decorative patterns. The overall layout features peony flowers arranged in a rectangular pattern, with branches and the simple, flowing 'ruyi' motif filling the gaps, creating a visually balanced and uniform composition.
description.zh: 主要对象为牡丹花，牡丹花花瓣饱满且层次分明，排列整齐，次要对象为细长的枝叶与如意纹，枝叶呈弧形流动，分布于花朵之间并连接上下的图案，如意纹简洁流畅贯穿元素，整体布局中牡丹花排列成规整的矩形模式，枝叶和如意纹填充缝隙形成装饰性的连续性，使画面显得层次分明且均匀。

description.en: Peony has long been considered a symbol of prosperity and status in Chinese culture, while the interlaced scroll motif symbolizes the continuation and cycle of life. The addition of the ruyi motif further emphasizes auspicious meanings. The interplay of branches and leaves embodies the harmony of movement. The overall pattern, arranged in rectangular shapes with decorative continuity, reflects the profound understanding of Song Dynasty artistry in terms of structural beauty and natural philosophy. This motif not only highlights the high skill of Song embroidery but also conveys the pursuit of vitality and harmony.
description.zh: 牡丹在中国传统文化中历来被视为富贵与繁荣的象征，而缠枝纹则寓意生命的延续与循环。如意纹的加入进一步强化了吉祥如意的美好寓意，枝叶间的流动感体现了自然运行的和谐法则。整体图案通过规整的矩形排列和装饰性的连续性，表现了宋代艺术对结构美感与自然哲理的深刻理解。这种纹样不仅反映了宋代织绣工艺的高超技巧，也传递了对生命力旺盛与和谐美满的追求。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 穿枝牡丹荔枝童子纹以童子坐姿为画面中心，围绕着饱满层叠的牡丹花、圆润丰盈的荔枝以及弧形穿插的枝叶构成了丰富的装饰性图案。童子形象生动，构成画面的视觉焦点，与周围意象形成了动静结合的对比。荔枝排列紧密，与细长枝叶交织穿插在牡丹花之间，创造了纹样的流动感和层次感。整体布局紧凑而有秩序，画面中各元素以连续性连接，形成充满动感和装饰美感的画面，体现了宋代织绣设计的精巧与复杂性。

description.en: Childhood in Chinese traditional culture symbolizes prosperity and life's blessings. Peony symbolizes prosperity and flourishing. The lotus represents abundance and sweetness. Branches and leaves symbolize the natural flow of life. The harmony of the child and the natural imagery in the painting expresses a beautiful vision of life and also highlights the natural law of cycles. The close and even arrangement of the patterns deeply reflects the profound understanding of the Song Dynasty artists about the interplay of movement and stillness, as well as the pursuit of the continuation of life and harmony with nature. This design perfectly combines the decorative nature and cultural connotations of Song Dynasty embroidery works.
description.zh: 童子在中国传统文化中寓意人丁兴旺与生活吉祥，牡丹象征富贵繁荣，荔枝代表丰收与甜美，而枝叶则体现生命的自然流动与延续。画面中童子与自然意象的融合表达了和谐美好的生命愿景，同时也展现了循环运行的自然法则。纹样的排列紧密且均匀，既体现宋代艺术对动静结合的深刻理解，又传递了对生命力延绵与自然和谐的追求。这种设计体现了宋代织绣作品中装饰性与文化意涵的完美结合。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

title.en: Boys, Lychees, and Peonies amid Interlaced Branches

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹纹以牡丹花为主要视觉意象，牡丹花瓣层叠饱满，展现出丰富的纹理感与立体效果。枝叶细长且优美，以弧形姿态自然分布于花朵之间，藤蔓则穿插交织于牡丹与枝叶之间，形成流动感十足的连接结构。画面中牡丹花均匀排列，构成连续且具有节奏感的图案，枝叶与藤蔓的巧妙填充增强了画面的紧凑感与完整性。整体布局在富有装饰性的同时，呈现出和谐、生动且均衡的视觉美感。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵繁荣，而缠枝纹寓意生命的循环与生生不息，两者的结合体现出对自然和谐美满与生命力旺盛的追求。枝叶与藤蔓的交错穿插象征生命力量的延续和自然运行的规律，画面布局的连贯性则彰显了生命和自然之间的紧密联系。这种设计不仅体现了宋代织绣艺术对形式美的追求，还蕴含了深厚的文化内涵，传递出对自然秩序、生命繁盛与和谐繁荣的美好向往。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹鸳鸯纹满布整幅画面，以层叠饱满的牡丹花为主要视觉点，花朵形态自然优美，呈现出多重纹理感。缠枝与枝叶以细长弧线交织穿插，连接各个意象，构成流动且连贯的装饰性结构。画面中间安排飞翔的鸳鸯，四足姿态栩栩如生，其动态感与植物纹样的静态构成鲜明对比，形成生动的画面构图。整体纹样布局紧凑而富有层次感，牡丹与缠枝均匀分布，飞翔鸳鸯贯穿其中，使画面充满生命力与和谐之美。

description.en: Peony flowers symbolize prosperity and harmony, while mandarin ducks symbolize fidelity and family harmony in Chinese culture. The interlaced scroll motif, with its interwoven scroll pattern, symbolizes the cycle of life and the movement of nature, perfectly capturing the essence of flourishing life and harmony. The mandarin ducks flying among the flowers reinforce the idea of harmony between humans and nature, creating a dynamic interplay of movement and stillness. This motif not only reflects the exquisite embroidery techniques of the Tang dynasty but also conveys profound cultural meanings of love, life, and harmony with nature.
description.zh: 牡丹花象征富贵繁荣，而鸳鸯在中国文化中寓意忠贞爱情与家庭和睦。缠枝纹寓意生命循环与自然运行，三者的结合恰到好处地表达了对生命繁盛与和谐美好的追求。飞翔鸳鸯贯穿于自然花草之间，强化了人与自然相融的理念，形成了动静交织的画面语言。这种纹样不仅体现了唐代刺绣工艺的精湛技艺，也传递了对爱情、生命与自然和谐的深刻文化内涵。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

title.en: Interlaced Scroll Peony Mandarin Ducks Pattern

description.en: Double Phoenix Peony Pattern features a central arrangement of peonies with petals layered outward, exuding vitality and depth. The phoenixes are arranged in a ring shape around the peonies, their graceful poses and curved wings create a symmetrical composition. The water patterns and stream-lined decorative elements interlace between the phoenixes and peonies, enhancing the dynamic and rhythmic quality of the image, making the overall composition balanced and decorative.
description.zh: 双凤牡丹纹以牡丹花居于画面中央，花瓣层层叠叠向外开放，饱满而富有立体感，突显了富贵与生机的象征。两只凤凰围绕牡丹环形排列，姿态优雅，身体呈弧形弯曲，羽毛纹理流畅且延展突出，头部与尾部分别位于图案的上下方，形成和谐对称的构图。纹样中的水纹与流线型装饰线条穿插于凤凰与牡丹之间，增强了画面的动态感与节奏感，使整体构图均衡而富有装饰性。

description.en: Peony symbolizes prosperity and flourishing, while the phoenix, as a sacred bird in Chinese culture, symbolizes auspiciousness and nobility. Together, they express a wish for harmony, prosperity, and happiness. The phoenix surrounds the peony, symbolizing the continuation of life's vitality and the cyclical nature of the natural world. The incorporation of water patterns and streamlined forms further emphasizes the flow of life and nature. This design not only decorates beautifully but also deeply conveys cultural meanings of auspicious prosperity, life cycles, and harmony with nature.
description.zh: 牡丹象征富贵繁荣，而凤凰作为中国传统文化中的神鸟，寓意祥瑞与高贵。二者结合，共同表达了对和谐美满、幸福繁盛的美好愿景。凤凰环绕牡丹，既体现了生命力的延续，也象征着循环运行的自然规律。水纹与流线型线条的融入进一步强化了自然与生命的流动意象。这种纹样设计不仅装饰精美，更蕴含了对吉祥繁荣、生命轮回与自然和谐的深刻文化内涵。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

description.en: Phoenix and Peony Pattern Features a phoenix as the main subject, showcasing a fluid, elegant posture. The phoenix is positioned at the center of the image, slightly to the right, with slender and elongated tail feathers that naturally extend upwards to the right. This displays a sense of lightness and fluidity. The phoenix is surrounded by blooming peonies, which are full and layered, with petals forming a curvilinear shape, creating a visual impression of prosperity and status. The branches and leaves interlace, forming a ring-like structure around the phoenix, adding depth and decorative elements to the image. The overall composition is tight and balanced, with each element complementing the other, resulting in an artistic effect of harmony, completeness, and liveliness.
description.zh: 凤凰牡丹纹以凤凰为主体，呈现出流线型的优雅姿态，位于画面的中心偏右位置，其尾羽纤细修长，向右上方自然延展，展现出动态的轻盈感。凤凰周围环绕着盛开的牡丹花，花朵饱满层次分明，花瓣呈弧形向外绽放，营造出富贵繁荣的视觉印象。枝叶交错分布，与凤凰身体和尾羽形成环抱式结构，增加了画面的层次感与装饰性。整体构图紧密、均衡，各元素彼此呼应，展现出和谐美满且生动的艺术效果。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 凤凰象征祥瑞与守护，牡丹寓意富贵繁荣，二者结合传递出吉祥祥瑞与富贵美满的文化内涵。枝叶的交织与凤凰的环绕布局象征自然的循环与生命的流动，体现了中国传统文化对和谐美好的追求。画面中的元素彼此呼应，形成一个完整且动态的生命与自然的生态系统。该纹样不仅表达了对高尚气质与生命力旺盛的赞美，还展现了人们对自然与祥瑞力量的崇敬。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

description.en: Double Phoenix and Peony Pattern features two phoenixes as the main subjects, positioned above the image, with their heads facing each other to create symmetry, while their bodies form an arc. Their wings and tail feathers extend in a streamlined form, showcasing a dynamic beauty. The peony flowers, centered below the phoenixes, are positioned at the center of the image, with full petals and distinct layers, radiating outward, symbolizing prosperity and abundance. Branches and buds are distributed in multiple layers, extending naturally outward, creating a visual harmony with the graceful curves of the phoenixes. The overall composition is tight and harmonious, with a balanced design and rich decorative elements, presenting a clear hierarchy of imagery while maintaining a sense of harmony.
description.zh: 双凤牡丹纹以两只凤凰为主体，位于画面上方，头部相对形成对称，身体呈弧形，翅膀与尾羽流线型地向两侧展开，展现出优雅与张力的动态美。下方的牡丹花居于凤凰下方的中心位置，花朵饱满，层次分明，花瓣向外绽放，显现出富贵与繁盛的意象。周围分布着多层次的枝叶与花蕾，枝叶自然向外延展，与凤凰的优雅弯曲形成呼应，整体构图紧密而协调。元素之间相辅相成，设计平衡且富有装饰性，意象层次鲜明，同时充满和谐的美感。

description.en: Phoenixes symbolize auspiciousness and protection, while peonies symbolize prosperity and flourishing. Together, they express the desire for a harmonious life and prosperity. Two symmetrical phoenixes surrounding a peony in a ring-shaped composition symbolize the cycle of life and the balance of nature, reflecting the profound Chinese tradition of praising life and achieving harmony with nature. The extension of leaves and buds further emphasize the flourishing theme, while the overall pattern not only conveys high taste but also conveys an infinite hope for auspiciousness and vitality.
description.zh: 凤凰象征祥瑞与守护，牡丹寓意富贵与繁荣，两者结合表达了对生活美满与幸福和谐的向往。两只对称凤凰围绕牡丹成环形构图，象征了生命的循环与自然的平衡，体现了中国传统文化中对生命力的赞美与自然和谐的深刻追求。枝叶与花蕾的延展进一步强化了繁盛的寓意，整体图案不仅展现了高尚的品味，还传递了对吉祥祥瑞与生命力旺盛的无限期望。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

description.en: This phoenix peony motif features a circular border, integrating peonies and phoenixes into the composition. The peonies are placed on the left, with a sense of fullness and distinct layers, with varied petal arrangements and interwoven branches. The phoenixes are positioned on the right, with a curved body around the border, wings spread, and flowing tail feathers, highlighting the dynamic beauty and liveliness of the phoenix. The peonies and phoenixes complement each other, creating a balanced layout. The entire design is enclosed within a circular border, with a tight and orderly composition, where each element is interconnected, achieving both decorative and fluid effects.
description.zh: 该凤凰牡丹纹纹样以圆形边框为基础，将牡丹花与凤凰巧妙地结合在画面中。牡丹花位于左侧，花朵饱满层次分明，花瓣排列错落有致，枝叶交错分布，衬托出花朵的富贵与优雅。凤凰位于右侧，身体呈弧形围绕边框，翅膀张开，尾羽流畅延展，强调了凤凰的动态美与灵动感。牡丹与凤凰相互呼应，构成平衡的布局。整体图案框于圆形边框内，画面紧密有序，各元素彼此关联，既具装饰性又富有流动感。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 凤凰象征祥瑞与通灵，牡丹寓意富贵与繁荣，两者在圆形构图中结合，体现了生命循环与自然和谐的寓意。这种纹样设计不仅传递了对幸福繁荣的追求，还表达了对自然和生命繁盛的赞美。圆形边框的使用进一步强调了构图的整体性与永恒感，展现了中国传统文化中对完美平衡与吉祥和谐的深刻追求。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

description.en: This rice ear pattern consists of an elliptical frame with circular motifs arranged in a repeating pattern, forming a continuous decorative strip. The elliptical frame is uniform in size, with circular motifs featuring rice ears. The rice ears are depicted as point-like lines, symbolizing the fullness and prosperity of the rice. The space between the ellipses is filled with diamond-shaped patterns, which also feature rice ear motifs, enhancing the pattern's complexity and richness. The overall composition is tight, with the geometric arrangement of the pattern elements showcasing order and harmony, with a prominent decorative effect and rhythmic appeal.
description.zh: 该稻穗纹以椭圆形和内部稻穗状的小图案为主要构成元素，整体呈重复排列，形成连续的装饰带状布局。椭圆形框体大小均匀，内部饰有稻穗状细节，稻穗形状以点状线条表达，体现稻谷的饱满与繁盛。椭圆形之间以菱形图案填充，菱形空间内同样嵌有稻穗形状的小图案，增强纹样的层次感与丰富性。整体构图紧密，图案元素之间的几何化排列展现出秩序与和谐美，装饰效果突出且富有韵律感。

description.en: The rice ears motif praises the agricultural culture by celebrating the abundance and vitality. It symbolizes the interaction between nature and human labor achievements. The repetition of the circular frame and the rice ears conveys the understanding of the cyclical nature and the movement of the universe, reflecting the Madiyaoya culture's prayer for the harvest in the agricultural society and respect for natural harmony. The combination of the rhombus and the rice ears further emphasizes the laws of nature and the inexhaustible cycle. The visual aspect of the rice ears motif conveys a sense of solemnity and order, reflecting the early civilizations' reverence and reliance on agricultural life.
description.zh: 稻穗纹表达了农业文化中对丰收与生命力的礼赞，是自然与人类劳动成果的象征。椭圆形框体与稻穗的重复排列传递了对生命循环与自然运行的认知，体现了马家窑文化对农耕社会丰收的祈愿与自然和谐的尊重。菱形与稻穗的结合进一步增强了对自然规律与生生不息的寓意。稻穗纹在视觉上呈现出一种庄重与秩序感，反映了早期文明对农耕生活的崇敬与依赖。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: This rice ear pattern features a central theme of rice ears, arranged in a vertical and upward orientation. The rice ears radiate from the base of the ear, forming multiple curvilinear structures. The lines of the rice ears are clear and natural, with grain points and short lines depicting the rice grains, arranged in a dense manner, highlighting the fullness and prosperity of the rice. Space is left between the ears to emphasize their layers. The fine point-like patterns at the top symbolize the vigorous growth of rice grains, adding dynamism to the composition. The overall composition is simple, while maintaining a strong decorative and symbolic quality, reflecting the vitality of nature and life.
description.zh: 该稻穗纹以稻穗为主要意象，呈现出直立向上的构图，稻穗从底部根部向上分散开来，形成多个弧形穗状结构。每根稻穗的线条清晰且弯曲自然，穗粒以点状和短线刻画，紧密排列，展现稻穗的饱满与繁盛。穗间留有适度空间，突出稻穗的层次感。顶部的细小点状纹样象征稻谷的蓬勃生长，同时赋予画面动感。整体构图简洁，同时具有鲜明的装饰性与象征意义，体现了自然与生命力的活力。

description.en: The rice ear motif symbolizes the prosperity of agricultural civilization and the flourishing of the Hemudu culture. The upward composition of the pattern conveys vitality and the perpetuation of life, while also reflecting the Hemudu culture's understanding and respect for natural laws. The fullness of the rice ear motif symbolizes abundance and harmony, reflecting the early agricultural society's celebration of the harvest and gratitude to nature's bounty. This motif not only serves as a decorative pattern but also acts as a carrier of cultural and spiritual ideas.
description.zh: 稻穗纹象征丰收与农业文明的兴盛，是自然生命力与人类劳动成果的体现。纹样向上的构图寓意生机勃勃和生命的繁衍不息，同时也传递了河姆渡文化对自然运行规律的理解与敬畏。稻穗饱满的形态象征富足与和谐，表现出早期农耕社会对丰收的庆祝及对自然恩赐的感恩。这一纹样不仅是装饰图案，更是文化与精神理念的传递载体。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: This grape squirrel motif features a dynamic interlaced scroll composition. The overall design is vibrant and dynamic. The main subject is a cluster of grapes, with their seeds full and colors rich, interwoven with branches and leaves, forming a dense decorative pattern. The interwoven vine flows, enhancing the visual depth and naturalness of the composition. The squirrel, moving between the branches and leaves, either foraging or playing, adds dynamism and narrative to the motif. The purple leaves and green vines contrast with the red and yellow grapes, adding visual diversity. The overall composition integrates the natural ambiance with decorative effects, achieving complexity and harmony.
description.zh: 该葡萄松鼠纹以动态的缠枝构图展开，整体设计充满生机与动感。纹样主体为累累果实的葡萄串，其颗粒饱满、色彩丰富，与枝叶交织形成繁密的装饰图案。缠枝藤蔓蜿蜒流动，强化了画面的层次感与自然感。次要意象松鼠穿梭于葡萄枝叶之间，或驻足觅食，或攀爬嬉戏，增强了纹样的灵动性与故事性。紫色叶片和绿色藤蔓的色彩搭配富有张力，与点缀的红、黄葡萄形成对比，为纹样增添了视觉上的多样性。整体构图融自然意境与装饰效果于一体，兼具复杂性与和谐美。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 葡萄松鼠纹象征丰收、生命的繁茂与自然的和谐运行。葡萄累累成串寓意生活富足与家族兴旺，松鼠作为活泼灵动的生物，增添了趣味与生机，展现人与自然的和谐共处。缠枝藤蔓的设计表现了生命的循环与绵延，暗喻自然之力的生生不息。该纹样不仅是装饰图案，也承载了对自然生命力的礼赞与对和谐生活的美好追求。它常用于器物尤其是瓷瓶的表面装饰，表达对自然与生命的双重敬意。

sourceReference: 其他_纹饰之美：中国纹样的秘密（涂睿明）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 松柏鹿纹以圆形构图呈现自然景象，中心位置为两只鹿，一只昂首，一只低头，姿态生动，表现出悠然自得的状态。鹿周围环绕着松树、花卉、云朵与石块，松树枝叶朝不同方向舒展，展现出动态的自然景观。背景运用细密的纹理增强了画面的层次感与自然氛围。松树的挺拔与鹿的灵动形成视觉上的和谐美，景物之间相互依存，构成了完整的自然生态场景。整体布局平衡有序，兼具生动性与装饰性。

description.en: Pine and deer motif symbolizes a harmonious relationship between longevity, resilience, and natural harmony. Pine trees in Chinese culture symbolize longevity and resilience, while deer symbolize prosperity and good fortune. Together, they form a harmonious relationship with nature, reflecting the pursuit of vitality and health. The addition of clouds and stones further emphasizes the theme of natural movement, embodying the philosophy of human coexistence with nature. This motif is commonly found on Ming dynasty decorative objects, particularly on round boxes, where natural imagery conveys wishes for good fortune and spiritual aspirations.
description.zh: 松柏鹿纹象征健康长寿、傲骨铮铮的品格与自然和谐。松树在中国传统文化中寓意长寿与坚韧，鹿则象征繁荣与吉祥，二者构成和谐的自然关系，表达了对生命力和健康的追求。云朵与石块的点缀进一步强化了自然运行的主题，体现出人与自然共生的哲学思想。该纹样常用于明代器物装饰，尤其是圆盒，通过自然意象传递美好愿望与精神诉求。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）
整体-时期_中国传统图案赏析（李学英）
中国图案大系（张道一）第8卷 清代 上
中国图案大系（张道一）第9卷 清代 上

description.en: This motif features a multi-layered, symmetrical arrangement of petals, radiating outward from the center. The petals are full and elegant, with distinct layers, each adorned with flowing arcs and intricate patterns. The design is characterized by a contrast of black and white, resulting in a simple, elegant, and ancient appearance. The motif emphasizes symmetry and balance, symbolizing cosmic order and natural harmony, and exerts a strong visual impact, imbuing the artistic pattern with a sense of grandeur and mystique.
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样以多层次对称的花瓣为主要构图元素，从中心向外辐射，呈现出精致而繁复的结构美感。花瓣形态饱满优雅，内外层次分明，每一片花瓣都饰有流畅的弧线和细腻的纹样，轮廓清晰而富有装饰性。纹样以黑白对比为主，整体简洁古朴，突出图案的立体感和庄重氛围。宝相花的构图强调对称与均衡，象征宇宙的秩序与自然的和谐，同时具有强烈的视觉冲击力，赋予艺术纹样高贵与神秘的气质。

image.localReference: 自然/花卉/宝相花/宝相花_002(1).png

description.en: Buddhism and natural imagery are integrated into the intricate design of the Bo Hua flower, symbolizing the flourishing of life, cosmic harmony, and spiritual elevation. The layers of petals and the central structure reflect the cyclical and continuous nature of life, conveying a transcendent spiritual communication. The black and white tones enhance the solemnity of the design, symbolizing authority and the spirit of protection, expressing reverence for sacred forces. The Bo Hua pattern is a classic example of decorative art, with deeper cultural and religious significance.
description.zh: 宝相花作为中国传统纹样，融合了佛教文化和自然意象，以其繁复的设计象征生命的繁茂、宇宙的和谐美好以及精神的升华。花瓣的层次与中心结构体现了生命的循环与连续性，同时传达出一种超越世俗的通灵意境。黑白色调增强了纹样的庄严感，隐喻权威与守护的精神内涵，表达了对神圣力量的敬畏与追求。宝相花纹样不仅是装饰艺术的经典代表，其背后更蕴含了深厚的文化与宗教意义。

sourceReference: 整体-物像_中国经典纹样图鉴(黄清穗)

description.en: This motif consists of a multi-layered radial arrangement of petals, presenting a symmetrical, complex, and aesthetically pleasing visual effect. The center is decorated with a circular motif, while the petals radiate outward, forming a well-organized radial layout. The petals are full and well-defined, with intricate patterns along their edges, enhancing the visual depth and dynamism of the design. The curves and ornaments connect the inner and outer petals naturally, presenting a balanced structure while exuding a sense of harmony. The contrast of black and white is simple and solemn, highlighting the three-dimensionality and sacred aura of the design, making it a classic in decorative art.
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样以多层放射状花瓣构成，呈现出对称、繁复而精美的视觉效果。花纹的中心由圆形装饰构成，向外延伸的花瓣层层展开，形成井然有序的放射状布局。花瓣形态饱满规整，边缘装饰以细密的纹样，增强了图案的层次感与动态美。内部花瓣和外部花瓣之间通过曲线和纹饰自然连接，整体纹样既呈现出结构的严谨，又散发出和谐的美学气息。黑白对比的色调简洁而庄重，凸显纹样的立体感和圣洁气息，使其成为装饰艺术中的经典之作。

image.localReference: 自然/花卉/宝相花/宝相花_002(2).png

description.en: Buddha's Wheel Pattern symbolizes the perfection and sanctity of Buddhism, reflecting its worship of harmony between nature and the universe. The petals unfold in a circular pattern, symbolizing the cyclical nature of life and the order of the cosmos, and expressing the purity of the spirit and the transcendence of secularism. The central circle represents the core of Buddhism, while the surrounding petals symbolize boundless compassion and broad wisdom. The black and white tones convey a sense of solemnity and respect, further reinforcing the religious connotations and protective mission of the pattern. The Buddha's Wheel Pattern is not only a decorative motif but also a profound expression of religious faith.
description.zh: 宝相花纹样作为佛教艺术的重要意象，象征着完美与圣洁，体现了佛教对自然与宇宙和谐的崇拜。花瓣层层展开，隐喻生命的循环与宇宙的秩序，表达了精神的纯净与超越世俗的神圣境界。圆形中心代表佛法的核心，外延的花瓣则象征无边的慈悲与宽广的智慧。黑白色调传递出庄重与肃穆的氛围，进一步强化了纹样的宗教含义和守护的精神使命。宝相花不仅是装饰纹样，更是一种宗教信仰的深刻表达。

sourceReference: 整体-物像_中国经典纹样图鉴(黄清穗)

description.en: This motif is a symmetrical arrangement of floral patterns. The design is intricate and follows a pattern. The central motif is a central flower, surrounded by curled branches and leaves, and elegant lines. The composition is soft and orderly. Each petal layer of the flowers is clearly defined, with the floral centers depicted by simple lines. The overall effect is a vibrant and energetic life force. The flowers are connected to the branches and leaves by smooth curves, creating a sense of continuity and unity. The motif is created with single-color lines, highlighting the decorative quality of the pattern, making it suitable for textile, architecture, or object decoration.
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样以纵向排列的结构呈现，图案对称精巧，富有规律性。花纹以主花形为核心，周围辅以卷曲的枝叶和优雅的线条装饰，形成柔美而有序的构图。每组花形的花瓣层次分明，花蕊部分以简约的线条表现，整体呈现出蓬勃向上的生命力。主花与枝叶之间通过流畅的曲线自然连接，构成视觉上的连续性和整体感。纹样以单色线条绘制，细腻的线条设计凸显装饰纹样的工艺美，适合用于织物、建筑或器物上的点缀。

image.localReference: 自然/花卉/宝相花/宝相花_003(1).png

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样在中国传统文化中象征富贵与吉祥，寓意生命的繁盛与自然的和谐。宝相花作为民间常见纹饰，不仅表达了对美好生活的向往，还体现出植物在自然中的生生不息与循环之意。通过对称的构图和流畅的线条，宝相花纹样传达了一种秩序与平衡之美，同时也起到守护和祝福的作用。其简洁而优雅的设计适合不同载体，成为民间装饰中不可或缺的吉祥元素。

sourceReference: 民族_蒙古族图案（阿木尔巴图）

description.en: This motif features a symmetrical composition with a central cluster of lotus flowers, petals layered in a smooth manner, and a central core that is lush and full of vitality. The lotus flowers are surrounded by intricate scrolling foliage and small floral decorations, which are connected by curvilinear lines, creating a sense of movement and harmony. The corners are embellished with symmetrical decorative motifs, drawing attention and creating a visual flow. The design is structured with clear geometric boundaries, highlighting the beauty of the central lotus flowers, showcasing the meticulous craftsmanship of traditional techniques.
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样呈现出规则对称的构图，中央部分是一簇盛开的宝相花，花瓣层叠有序，花心流畅饱满，展现饱满的生命力。宝相花周围环绕着精美的卷草纹和小花饰，它们以弧形线条连接，使整体画面充满流动感与和谐美。纹样的四角以相互对称的装饰花纹点缀，形成视觉的聚焦与延展。整个设计以几何形状为框架，边界线条清晰，突出了中心花卉的华美，展示出传统工艺的精湛技艺。

image.localReference: 自然/花卉/宝相花/宝相花_003(2).png

description.en: Bohän Hua is a symbol of prosperity and good fortune in Chinese culture, with its elaborate floral design and symmetrical structure representing harmony, prosperity, and flourishing life. The blooming center of the flower symbolizes the vitality of life, while the scrolling foliage and small flowers surrounding it convey the beauty of nature's abundance and cyclical growth. This pattern is commonly found on furniture and wooden objects, serving both as an aesthetic decoration and a wish for family prosperity and happiness. It exemplifies the integration of symbolic meaning and practical functionality in Chinese culture.
description.zh: 宝相花在中国传统文化中是富贵和吉祥的象征，其华丽的花型和对称的结构代表了完美、和谐与繁荣。中心花形的盛放体现了生命蓬勃发展的生机，与周围环绕的卷草纹和小花装饰共同展现出自然的繁茂与循环之美。这种纹样通常出现在家具和木器等日用品上，既作为审美装饰，又寄寓对兴旺幸福、家族兴盛的美好愿景，是中国传统文化中象征意义与实用功能结合的典范。

sourceReference: 民族_蒙古族图案（阿木尔巴图）

description.en: The design features a symmetrical radial arrangement of the floral pattern centered on a ring-shaped motif. The central flower has distinct layers of petals, creating a full and visually striking form. This forms a focal point. The surrounding flowers are arranged in a regular ring pattern, complementing the central flower to achieve a harmonious and unified whole. The flowing lines and smooth curves of the design connect the floral elements through intricate leaf patterns, creating a sense of natural rhythm. The overall design is balanced and rhythmic, presenting a structured and decorative aesthetic.
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样采用中心对称的环形布局，主花位于中心，周围以放射状排列多个装饰性花朵和细节纹样。主花的花瓣层次分明，呈现出饱满的形态，形成视觉焦点。外围的花朵以规则的环形结构排列，与中央主花构成和谐统一的整体。纹样中线条流畅，曲线优美，意象之间通过细致的花叶纹样相连，营造出自然流动的视觉节奏。整体设计均衡且充满韵律，呈现出井然有序的结构感与装饰美学。

image.localReference: 自然/花卉/宝相花/宝相花_005(2).png

description.en: This motif embodies the harmony and life philosophy of Tang Dynasty. The lotus flowers symbolize the prosperity and nobility of life, while the ring-shaped layout and repeated flowers express the cyclical nature of the natural world and the continuous flow. The symmetrical and regular arrangement also reflects the philosophical ideas of order and harmony, highlighting the aesthetic height and spiritual depth of Tang Dynasty culture. This motif not only represents artistic decoration but also carries the auspicious meanings of prosperity and safety.
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样蕴含了唐代文化中的和谐与生命理念。宝相花象征生命的繁荣与尊贵，环形的布局和重复的花朵表达了自然界的循环与生生不息之意。同时，纹样的对称与规整性体现了秩序与和谐的哲学思想，彰显了唐代文化的审美高度与精神内涵。这种纹样不仅是艺术装饰的体现，还承载了祈愿富贵、护佑平安的吉祥寓意。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: The rhinoceros motif is circularly arranged, with the rhinoceros centered, drawing attention to itself. The rhinoceros is depicted as full and dignified, with intricate grid-like patterns on its body. This adds decorative and sculptural qualities. A ring-shaped border of floral elements surrounds the rhinoceros, arranged symmetrically. The floral patterns are arranged in radial symmetry, creating a balanced and orderly layout. The floral motifs are rich in detail, with fine, flowing lines. They complement the circular outer border, creating an outwardly radiating effect. The repeated floral elements add rhythmic movement, enhancing the visual fluidity and dynamism.
description.zh: 该犀牛宝相花纹样以圆形构图展开，犀牛位于中心位置，成为视觉焦点。犀牛形态饱满、神态庄重，身上刻有网格状纹路，赋予其装饰性和力量感。犀牛周围环绕着一圈由花卉元素组成的环形装饰，这些花卉呈现对称排列，整体布局均衡且有序。花卉纹样细节丰富，线条纤巧流畅，与外层圆形构图相互呼应，形成向外扩展的辐射感。重复的花卉元素赋予纹样节奏感，同时增强了视觉上的流动性与动态感。

image.localReference: 自然/花卉/宝相花/宝相花_005(3).png

description.en: This motif embodies the authority and protection symbolism of Tang Dynasty culture. The rhinoceros, as the central motif, symbolizes power and authority, capable of awe-inspiring others while also conveying a sense of protection and peace. The interwoven lotus patterns around the rhinoceros express harmony between nature and life, praising the Tang Dynasty's craftsmanship for its reverence of perpetual life and beauty. The motif's symmetry and circular layout further reinforce the cycles and harmony philosophy, while also highlighting the grandeur and elegance of royal vessels.
description.zh: 该纹样蕴含了唐代文化中的权威和守护寓意。犀牛作为中心意象，象征力量与权威，既能震慑外界，又具有护佑和平的象征意义。而环绕犀牛的宝相花纹样表现了自然与生命的和谐，传递了唐代工艺对生生不息与美好生活的礼赞。纹样的对称性与圆形布局进一步强化了循环与和谐的哲学思想，同时彰显了皇家器物的尊贵与精美。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

title.en: Rhinoceros Baoxiang Flower Silver Box Pattern

description.en: This motif features a continuous horizontal composition. The main subject is a symmetrical and ornamental lotus flower. The flowers are predominantly blue and green in color, with a clear hierarchy and full, round petals. They are connected by scroll patterns, creating smooth, beautiful lines that evoke a sense of natural rhythm. The internal details of each flower are meticulously decorated, with petals arranged closely and orderly, creating a harmonious transition with the surrounding scroll patterns, enhancing the overall visual impact and decorative quality of the composition. The color scheme is rich and varied, balancing the visual hierarchy while highlighting the opulence and elegance of the lotus flowers.
description.zh: 该宝相花纹样以横向连续构图呈现，主体为具有对称性和装饰性的宝相花，花朵以蓝色和绿色为主要色调，层次分明且饱满圆润。花朵之间通过卷草纹连接，线条流畅优美，营造出自然生动的视觉节奏。每一朵花的内部细节装饰精致，花瓣间排列紧密而有序，与周围的卷草纹样形成和谐的过渡，增强了画面的整体感和装饰性。色彩搭配深浅有致，既体现了视觉上的层次感，又烘托出宝相花的华丽与典雅。

image.localReference: 自然/花卉/宝相花/宝相花_005(4).png

description.en: This motif embodies the harmonious and natural philosophy of the Yuan dynasty. The Puxiang flower symbolizes life and prosperity, while the arrangement of flowers and the connection of scrollwork reflect the philosophical idea of interdependence and harmony among all things. The blue-green tones symbolize the vitality of life and the tranquility of nature, while also showcasing the unique aesthetic of Yuan dynasty craftsmanship. The continuous composition and the extension of the motifs convey the cultural concept of cycles and movement, embodying the eternal life philosophy and the praise of nature's beauty.
description.zh: 该纹样体现了元代时期的和谐与自然观念。宝相花象征生命与繁荣，花卉的排列及卷草纹的连接体现了万物相生相依、自然和谐的哲学思想。蓝绿的色调寓意生命的生机和自然的宁静，同时展现了元代工艺的独特审美。连续的构图和纹样延展则传递了循环与运行的文化意涵，体现了生生不息的生命理念及对大自然美好的礼赞。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: The group of lotus dragon motifs feature a spiraling dragon as the main subject, arranged in a circular composition. The overall design exudes a sense of movement and visual impact. The dragon's body twists and turns, forming a closed circular structure. The head is raised and the body is coiled inward, giving the impression of majesty and readiness. The scales cover the body, with fine textures and intricate decorations. The limbs and paw designs are forceful, with exaggerated head shapes and expressive forms. The dragon's writhing form contrasts with the fine lines, giving the motif a dynamic and balanced visual effect. The entire motif embodies both the vitality of nature and the symmetrical and structural beauty of decorative art.
description.zh: 该团花龙纹纹样以盘旋的龙为主体，呈圆形构图，整体具有强烈的动势感和视觉冲击力。龙的身体蜿蜒交错，构成了圆形的闭合结构，龙头高昂并向内收拢，显得威严且蓄势待发。龙的鳞片铺满身体，纹理细腻，带有精致的装饰性，四肢及爪部的设计富有力量感，头部形态夸张且富有表现力。龙纹的怒卷形态与细致的线条形成鲜明对比，赋予纹样强烈的动感和均衡的视觉效果。整个纹样既具有生动自然的生命力，又展现了装饰艺术的对称性与结构美。

description.en: This motif of the dragon symbolizes authority and protection. As the sacred dragon of Chinese culture, it represents supreme power and the mystical power of spiritual communication, symbolizing the king's authority and the divine mandate. The spiraling composition not only depicts the dragon's movement and cycle but also expresses the hope for peace and prosperity. The circular design further emphasizes harmony and order, reflecting the pursuit of authority and cultural meaning in the art of the Five Dynasties period.
description.zh: 此龙纹图案体现了权威与守护的文化语义。龙作为中国文化的神兽，象征着至高无上的权力与神秘通灵的力量，寓意君王的威严与天命。盘旋的构图不仅展现了龙的运行与循环，也表达了对保护和平与繁荣的期望。纹样的圆形设计则进一步强调了和谐与秩序的理念，体现了五代时期工艺美术在权威性与文化寓意上的追求。

sourceReference: 金属器_中国古代青铜金银器纹饰(张广立)

description.en: This double phoenix pattern is presented in a symmetrical composition, divided into two parts. Each part features a lifelike phoenix as the main subject. The phoenixes are fluidly designed, with graceful postures and beautiful wings. They extend their tails, showcasing a strong dynamic and majestic aura. The phoenixes' heads face each other, complementing each other, creating a harmonious and symmetrical visual layout. The background features scrolling foliage and cloud patterns, adding depth to the design, complementing the phoenixes' posture, enhancing the decorative and three-dimensionality of the motif. The entire motif is meticulously crafted, with smooth lines, possessing high artistic value.
description.zh: 该双凤团花纹以对称的构图形式呈现，图案被分为上下两部分，每部分以一只栩栩如生的凤凰为主体。凤凰造型流畅，姿态优美，羽翼张开，尾羽修长，展现出极强的动态感和威严气息。两只凤凰头部相对，彼此呼应，形成了一种对称和谐的画面布局。背景以云纹和流动的卷草纹为装饰，层次丰富，与凤凰的姿态相辅相成，增强了纹样的装饰性和立体感。整个纹样精雕细琢，线条流畅，具有极高的艺术价值。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 双凤团花纹象征着和谐与权威，同时寓意吉祥和繁荣。凤凰作为中国传统文化中的瑞鸟，象征着王后和女性的尊贵，双凤的相对图案寓意夫妻和美、阴阳调和。云纹与卷草纹在背景中的运用不仅增添了动态和层次感，还强化了凤凰出现在云间的仙气和通灵意义。这种纹样在五代时期的银器装饰中，既展现了高贵华丽的品味，也寄托了美好的祈福意愿。

sourceReference: 金属器_中国古代青铜金银器纹饰(张广立)

description.en: The double phoenix motif above and below is arranged symmetrically, with each part featuring a phoenix as the main subject. The phoenixes are depicted gracefully in the decorative background. The upper part of the phoenixes are in a posture of spreading wings, while the lower part is in a side view of the phoenixes with a gaze of contemplation. The feathers of the phoenixes are fine and full, with smooth lines and soft tail feathers, showcasing the elegance and nobility of the phoenixes. The background is composed of scrolling foliage and cloud patterns, complex but not chaotic, complementing the phoenixes' form. The entire motif is finely detailed, combining natural movement with the depth of the decorative patterns.
description.zh: 该双鹤团花纹以上下对称的形式构图，每部分以一只仙鹤为主体，在装饰性背景中优雅地展现。仙鹤姿态灵动，上部分的鹤呈展翅飞翔之势，下部分的鹤则以侧身凝视的姿态相互呼应。鹤的羽翼细密而饱满，线条流畅，尾羽柔和舒展，展现了仙鹤的高贵与优雅。背景由卷草纹和云纹交织而成，繁复而不紊乱，与鹤的造型形成动静结合的视觉效果。整个纹样细腻精美，既有自然生动的动态感，又强化了装饰纹样的层次感。

description.en: Double Crane Floral Pattern symbolizes harmony and longevity, conveying cultural meanings of naturalism, life, and harmony. The Crane, a symbol of longevity, good fortune, and transcendence in Chinese culture, is depicted as a couple with a complementary pattern, signifying the harmony and mutual protection of spouses. The scrolling foliage and cloud patterns further emphasize the Crane's image of living in a natural paradise, conveying a sense of spiritual communication and transcendence from the mundane world. This motif not only represents decorative art but also reflects the cultural aspirations of the Five Dynasties for naturalism, life, and harmony.
description.zh: 双鹤团花纹象征着自然与生命，同时传达了和谐美好的文化寓意。仙鹤在中国传统文化中常被视为长寿、吉祥与超凡脱俗的象征，双鹤相对的图案寓意着夫妻之间的和美与相互守护。背景中的云纹与卷草纹进一步突显了仙鹤栖息于自然仙境的意象，传递出通灵之感和超脱世俗的理念。此纹样不仅是装饰艺术的体现，更是五代时期对自然、生命及和谐共存的文化追求。

sourceReference: 金属器_中国古代青铜金银器纹饰(张广立)

description.en: This composition of circular patterns with scrolling foliage above and below, featuring a circular arrangement of one peacock per section, elegantly showcases the peacock's grace and beauty. The peacock's posture is cleverly designed, with its head slightly inclined forward and its tail feathers spread and dignified. The intricate feather patterns and the arrangement of the tail feathers highlight the unique beauty of decorative art. The background is composed of complex scrolling foliage and petal-shaped decorations, contrasting with the peacock's body, creating a static and dynamic relationship. The fine depiction of the tail feathers and the complementary decorative patterns further emphasize the peacock's nobility and splendor, making the entire motif round and full, with significant visual impact.
description.zh: 该孔雀团花纹以上下分割的圆形构图形式呈现，每部分以一只孔雀为主体，优雅地展现了孔雀的灵动与华美。孔雀姿态巧妙，头部微微前倾，尾羽舒展而隆重，细腻的羽毛纹理及尾羽的排列展现了装饰艺术的独特之美。背景以繁复的卷草纹和花瓣形装饰构成，与孔雀的体态形成了静与动的对比关系，同时又彼此呼应。尾羽的精细刻画与装饰纹样搭配，突显了孔雀的高贵与艳丽，使整个纹样圆润饱满，具有极高的视觉张力。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 孔雀团花纹象征了生命与自然的和谐，同时传递了美丽与吉祥的文化寓意。孔雀在中国文化中常被视为高贵、优雅与繁荣的象征，作为凤凰的象征之一，孔雀也暗含通灵与神秘的意象。纹样中的背景装饰流畅而生动，象征着自然的循环与运行，寓意天地之间的和谐与繁盛。结合孔雀的形象与纹样整体的构成，体现了对生命的赞美及对自然之美的追求。

sourceReference: 金属器_中国古代青铜金银器纹饰(张广立)

description.en: Double Phoenix Pattern with Symmetrical Composition. Each part features a phoenix as the main subject, showcasing dynamic tension. The phoenixes are depicted in various postures, with the upper part showing the phoenixes flying gracefully, exuding both majesty and movement, while the lower part displays the phoenixes in a relaxed and elegant posture, with flowing tail feathers that gently curve, highlighting their fluidity and softness. The background is composed of cloud patterns and scrolling foliage, with intricate patterns and smooth lines that seamlessly blend with the phoenixes' movements, resulting in a refined decorative effect. The interplay of phoenixes enhances the harmony of the scene, while highlighting the phoenixes' grandeur and mystique.
description.zh: 双凤团花纹采用上下分割对称构图，每部分以一只凤凰为主体，展现了生动的画面张力。凤凰形象华美，姿态各异，上部分的凤凰展翅飞扬，显现出威严与动感，下部分的凤凰则显得舒展优雅，尾羽绵长，微微扭转，呈现灵动与柔和之美。背景由云纹和流动卷草纹构成，纹饰繁复且线条流畅，与凤凰的姿态完美融合，整体呈现出精致的装饰效果。凤凰间的相对呼应增强了画面的和谐美感，同时突出了主体的尊贵与神秘。

description.en: Double phoenix patterns symbolize authority and harmony, carrying sacred spiritual communication. The phoenix, as a sacred bird in Chinese culture, symbolizes royalty, prosperity, and good fortune. The symmetrical design of the phoenixes embodies the concept of Yin and Yang harmony and cosmic balance. The scrolling foliage and cloud patterns symbolize the cyclical nature of nature and life, imbuing the patterns with dynamism and an endless flow. This decorative motif not only reflects the artistic style of the Five Dynasties period but also conveys a desire for prosperity and longevity.
description.zh: 双凤团花纹象征着权威与和谐，同时承载了通灵的神圣寓意。凤凰作为中国传统文化中尊贵的神鸟，寓意王权、富贵和吉祥，双凤对称的设计体现了阴阳调和与天地和谐的理念。背景云纹与卷草纹则象征自然与生命的循环不息，赋予纹样灵动与生生不息的意境。这种纹饰不仅展现了五代时期的艺术风格，还表达了对繁盛与长久的文化追求。

sourceReference: 金属器_中国古代青铜金银器纹饰(张广立)

description.en: Tangka: Circular composition featuring the "Shou" character as the visual center, surrounded by lotus flowers and dragon motifs. The "Shou" character is designed with a black and white contrast, featuring simple and full lines that emphasize its visual impact. The dragon motifs surrounding the "Shou" character are dynamic and fluid, conveying the dragon's majesty and movement. The lotus flowers below are elegant, with distinct layers, contrasting with the dragon motifs, adding a soft touch to the decorative patterns. The overall layout is balanced, creating a harmonious visual effect of movement and stillness, reflecting a sense of unity and a wish for blessings.
description.zh: 团花祝寿纹呈圆形构图，以“寿”字为视觉中心，周围环绕着龙纹与花卉装饰图案。寿字采用黑白对比设计，线条简洁、饱满，强化了其突出效果。环绕寿字的龙纹形态生动，线条流转有力，展现出龙的威严与动感。下方的莲花形态优雅，瓣叶层次分明，与龙纹形成鲜明对比，增加了装饰纹样的柔美。整体布局均衡，寿字与装饰纹样之间构成了动静结合的和谐视觉效果，表现出一种凝聚力与祝福的形式美。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 团花祝寿纹寓意生命的延续和自然的循环，同时蕴含守护与权威的文化内涵。“寿”字作为核心主题，表达了对长寿与幸福的祝愿，而龙纹则象征权威与守护，体现了中国传统文化中龙的神圣地位。下方莲花的加入，传递了生生不息的自然意境和生命的繁荣。整体纹样不仅是一种视觉装饰，更是一种文化符号，体现了清代织锦艺术对吉祥、生命与权威的深刻追求。

sourceReference: 整体_中国纹样史（田自秉）

description.en: The lotus honeysuckle pattern is a continuous scroll of lotus flowers interlaced with honeysuckle, arranged evenly. The core of the lotus is a blooming lotus with layered petals, delicate and intricate, showcasing the lotus's elegance and vitality. Around the lotus, the honeysuckle extends outward, connected to the lotus pattern, creating a visual effect of four-way expansion. The honeysuckle extends smoothly with gentle curves, forming a relationship of contrast between movement and stillness, with a balance of complexity and simplicity. The pattern is arranged meticulously with a rhythmic flow, presenting a harmonious and flowing visual beauty.
description.zh: 莲花忍冬团花纹以经斜线为基础的缠枝构图呈现，图案整体均匀排列，形成连续重复的装饰效果。团花的核心是一朵盛开的莲花，莲瓣层叠有序，花心细腻，展现了莲花的典雅与生气。在莲花四周，忍冬纹向外延展，与团花紧密相连，形成四向的视觉扩展效果。忍冬纹以柔美的曲线延展，结构流畅，与主花形成了动静结合、繁简相应的关系。图案布局严谨而有节奏，整体呈现一种和谐且流动的视觉美感。

description.en: Lotus honeysuckle bunches symbolize the cycle of nature and life, embodying harmony and beauty. Lotus flowers symbolize purity and high moral integrity in Chinese culture, representing the prosperity and longevity of life. Honeysuckle patterns symbolize perpetual renewal and eternity. Together, they form a bunch, symbolizing the coexistence of nature and life, reflecting the cultural vision of harmony between humans and nature. This motif embodies the praise of nature and life by Tang Dynasty art and the pursuit of idealized order.
description.zh: 莲花忍冬团花纹表达了自然与生命的循环之意，同时蕴含了和谐美好的文化内涵。莲花在中国传统文化中象征清净高洁，代表生命的繁荣与持久，而忍冬纹则寓意生生不息与永恒。两者结合形成团花，象征自然和生命的共生循环，展现了人与自然和谐共存的文化愿景。这种纹饰体现了唐代艺术对自然和生命的歌颂以及对理想化秩序的追求。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 莲花团花纹采用对称的团花构图，以莲花为主体，呈现出复杂而精美的装饰效果。图案中，每个团花由两朵盛开的莲花组成，莲瓣排列紧密而饱满，层叠而富有韵律。莲花间以柔美的缠枝纹相连，形成流畅的动态感。背景以蓝地为底，衬托出白色图案的清新与优雅，同时增添了视觉上的层次感。团花间排列均匀，形成连续的装饰性织锦图案，既保持了整体的秩序，又展现了细节的丰富性。

description.en: The lotus pattern symbolizes harmony, life, and cyclical nature. Lotus flowers have long been symbolic of purity and prosperity. The double lotus design expresses the wish for the continuation of life and prosperity. The interlaced scroll adds the imagery of perpetual motion and natural cycles. The overall pattern in lotus form conveys harmony and completeness, reflecting the Northern Song period's pursuit of natural order and ideal aesthetics. This design not only embodies the beauty of decorative art but also carries profound cultural meanings.
description.zh: 莲花团花纹传递了自然、生命与循环的文化内涵。莲花自古以来是高洁与繁荣的象征，双重莲花的设计显示出对生命延续与繁盛的祝愿。缠枝纹的加入则传达了生生不息、自然循环的意象。整体图案以团花形式呈现，寓意和谐与圆满，反映了北宋时期对自然秩序与理想美学的追求。这种设计不仅体现了装饰艺术的美感，也承载了深厚的文化寓意。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

place.en: Yongle Palace, Three Pure Ones Hall

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 蔓草团花纹以连续的团花图案构成，团花由蔓草缠绕形成，与背景形成鲜明的线与面对比。纹样整体布局简洁，团花以流畅的曲线和动感构成叶片形态，呈现出自然生机与装饰性的美感。蔓草纹不仅彼此连接，还在团花之间形成延展性的装饰，构建出一种动态的流动感。团花元素大小经过精巧设计，通过面与线条的比例关系，增加了视觉层次感。整体图案充分体现了元代织金锦工艺的精致与对自然元素的高度提炼。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 蔓草团花纹象征生命的繁茂与自然循环，蕴含和谐的文化意蕴。蔓草的缠绕延伸，暗示生机盎然的自然景象与生命的延续。团花的对称性与连接性则反映了元代对于形式美与自然秩序的追求，同时也折射出对和谐与圆满的理想化表达。这种纹样不仅具有装饰功能，也体现了对自然世界生命力的礼赞，展现了元代文化中人与自然共存的哲学理念。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Phoenix group pattern featuring phoenixes with wings spread high, feathers flowing smoothly, conveying strong sense of movement and elegance. The arc-shaped cloud pattern surrounds the phoenix, creating a flowing diffusion effect, enhancing the dynamic and depth of the pattern. The visual focal point of the phoenix and the circular border formed by the cloud pattern create a harmonious relationship between the visual center and the ring-shaped composition. The entire pattern is enclosed by a circular border, making it more orderly and complete in terms of decorative design. Additionally, other plant patterns such as lotus are scattered throughout, complementing the phoenix and cloud pattern to create a decorative picture that combines natural elements with movement.
description.zh: 凤凰团花纹以凤凰为主体构成，凤凰展翅高飞，羽毛细致流畅，呈现出强烈的动感与优雅。围绕凤凰的是弧线状的云纹，云纹环绕凤凰形成流动扩散的效果，增强了图案的动态感和层次感。图案正中心的凤凰与外围云纹形成了视觉焦点与环状构图的和谐关系。整体被圆形边框框住，在装饰性上更显规整与完整，此外，图案中还点缀了莲花和其他植物纹样，与凤凰和云纹共同构成一幅自然与动感兼具的装饰画面。

description.en: Phoenix group pattern embodies the cultural spirit of nature, life, and harmony. The phoenix, a symbol of auspiciousness, nobility, and life flourishing in Chinese culture, symbolizes ascent and the burst of vitality. The cloud pattern, with its cycle and dynamic movement, signifies the natural cycle and dynamic operation. The addition of the lotus further deepens the life and purity symbolism. The fusion of phoenixes with natural elements embodies the harmony between heaven and earth, as well as between humans and nature. This pattern not only decorates but also expresses the ideal of natural vitality and social harmony in the Qing dynasty.
description.zh: 凤凰团花纹呈现了自然、生命与和谐的文化精神。凤凰在中国传统文化中是吉祥、高贵与生命繁盛的象征，展翅的姿态象征升腾与生命力的迸发，而云纹则意味着自然的循环与动态运行。莲花的加入进一步深化了生命与纯洁的寓意，凤凰与自然元素的结合体现了天与地、人与自然的和谐共存。这种纹样不仅是装饰，更是清代对自然生命力和社会和谐的理想表达。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 凤凰团花纹以飞翔的凤凰为主体构图，展翅的凤凰位于正中心，长羽流畅而优雅，赋予图案动态感与视觉张力。团花外围环绕着流动的云纹，云纹呈弧形弥漫，与凤凰的动势相呼应，形成环状的装饰布局。云纹的柔和线条与凤凰的流畅羽毛形成对比，使整个图案既富有层次，又显得自然流动。圆形边框将凤凰与云纹框在其中，增强了图案的完整性与装饰效果。整体布局以凤凰为核心，云纹与背景相辅相成，呈现出和谐的美学结构。

description.en: Phoenix group pattern symbolizes authority, nature, and harmony. It represents the ideal expression of auspicious symbolism and social order in Ming culture. The phoenix, as the king of birds, symbolizes nobility and authority, with its spread wings signifying ascent and prosperity. The cloud pattern surrounding the phoenix symbolizes the cyclical nature of the natural world and the movement of heaven and earth, hinting at the harmony between heaven and earth. The circular pattern embodies the concept of wholeness and unity, as well as the admiration for natural order and vitality in Ming textile patterns. This motif not only has decorative value but also carries deep cultural significance.
description.zh: 凤凰团花纹象征权威、自然与和谐，展现了明代文化中对吉祥寓意和社会秩序的理想表达。凤凰作为百鸟之王，象征高贵与权威，展翅的姿态寓意升腾与兴盛。环绕凤凰的云纹象征自然界的循环与运行，暗含天与地的和谐关系。圆形图案不仅体现了整体性与团圆的理念，也彰显了明代织物纹样中对于自然秩序与生命力的赞美。这种纹样不仅具有装饰作用，还承载了深厚的文化寓意。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该梅花纹样以五片花瓣环绕构成团花图案，整体造型简洁明快，花瓣呈圆润的几何形态，均匀分布形成规则的对称构图。梅花纹样的布局以梅花正中心为视觉焦点，五片花瓣呈放射状排列，体现出明晰的层次感。整体设计没有复杂的装饰元素，纯粹以线条与形状的简洁美感展现出自然的意象与协调性。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 梅花在中国传统文化中象征坚韧与生命力，五瓣梅花纹样寓意自然与生命的纯净美好。简洁有力的构图与规则的对称性，呈现出一种和谐与秩序感。同时，梅花纹样也包含守护的文化语义，暗示着梅花在寒冬中独自绽放的坚持与无畏，具有震慑与保护的意涵。这种纹样不仅用于装饰，更蕴含了深刻的哲学寓意，展现了人与自然相融的精神追求。

sourceReference: 整体-物像_中国经典纹样图鉴(黄清穗)

description.en: This plum blossom motif features a central flower bud, with five petals arranged symmetrically and compactly. The petals are round and full, with smooth edges, resulting in a simple yet lively design. The overall composition is balanced and stable, enhancing the plum blossom's natural vitality. The petals interlock closely, forming a cohesive visual effect, while the motif's regularity and symmetry convey a serene aesthetic, devoid of any excess decoration, highlighting the simplicity of the plant.
description.zh: 该梅花纹样以中心花蕊为核心，五片花瓣均匀排列，呈现出对称且紧凑的圆形构图。花瓣圆润饱满，边缘光滑，整体设计简洁而生动，强化了梅花自然生机的意象。每片花瓣之间连接紧密，形成团花状的稳定视觉效果，梅花纹样以其规则性和均衡性展现出一种静谧美感，没有多余的装饰元素，突出植物的朴素之美。

description.en: Plum blossoms symbolize resilience and life force in Chinese culture, with their five-petal patterns conveying a sense of harmony and natural cycles through simple design. Their blooming in winter represents the strength of life, while their cluster patterns also convey philosophical ideas of balance and natural succession. The motif symbolizes protection, embodying resilience and the spirit of overcoming challenges, subtly hinting at respect for life and nature. This motif not only has decorative value but also carries deep cultural significance.
description.zh: 梅花在中国文化中象征坚韧与生命力，五瓣梅花纹样通过简洁的设计表达了对自然与生命的赞美。梅花在寒冬盛开，代表了顽强的生命力，同时它的团花构型也传递出和谐与自然循环的哲学意涵。纹样蕴含守护的象征意义，象征着坚韧、抗击困难的精神，暗含对生命与自然的尊重。这种纹样不仅具有装饰功能，更承载了深厚的文化价值。

sourceReference: 整体-物像_中国经典纹样图鉴(黄清穗)

description.en: Red ground scrolling plum blossom pattern centered on the plum blossom motif, featuring a regular, continuous, and repetitive composition. The plum blossoms are five-petaled and evenly spread, with the flower center abstractly decorated by streamlined form patterns, imbuing the overall image with a sense of movement and vitality. Branches interlace with the plum blossoms, with buds of blossoms scattered on the branches, creating a dynamic effect of natural growth. The background is a dark base, highlighting the white plum blossoms in a fresh and elegant manner. The combination of branches and flowers creates a rhythmic sense of order, integrating decorative elements with natural beauty, resulting in a balanced and flowing overall layout, showcasing a refined artistic style.
description.zh: 红地折枝梅花纹以梅花图案为中心，呈现出规则的连续重复构图。梅花五瓣均匀展开，花心以抽象流线纹样装饰，赋予整体动感与生机。梅花间以枝条相连，枝条上点缀着含苞待放的花蕾，营造出自然生长的动态效果。背景为深色底，突显白色梅花的清新雅致。枝条和花朵的组合呈现出有序的节奏感，装饰性与自然美有机结合，整体布局既饱满又流畅，彰显出优雅的艺术风格。

description.en: Plum blossoms in Chinese culture symbolize resilience, purity, and vitality. The interplay of flowers and branches in the 'Red Ground Plum Blossom Branching Pattern' conveys the cyclical nature of life and vitality. The curving branches and blooming flowers highlight the resilience of life and the harmony of nature. The unique feature of the plum blossoms blooming in winter also conveys the spirit of overcoming challenges and the protective role. The stark contrast of dark background against the bright plum blossoms further emphasizes the resilience and purity of the flowers, paying homage to the natural life and spiritual pursuits.
description.zh: 梅花在中国传统文化中象征坚韧、纯洁与生命力，红地折枝梅花纹通过花朵与枝条的结合表现出自然循环与生机勃勃的意象。枝条的折曲与花朵的绽放展现了生命的韧性与自然的和谐美。加之梅花在寒冬盛开的特质，该纹样还传达了迎难而上的精神与守护的寓意。深色背景衬托白梅的鲜明对比，更加突出了梅花的顽强生机与高洁品质，传递出对自然生命与精神追求的礼赞。

sourceReference: 整体-物像_中国经典纹样图鉴(黄清穗)

title.en: Red-Ground Flowering Spray Plum Blossom Pattern

description.en: The motif is a single plum blossom pattern. The composition is simple and imbued with symbolic meaning. The five petals of the plum blossom are symmetrically arranged, with smooth lines that create a full and round shape. The center features a pointy arrangement to form the stamen, highlighting the meticulous details of the decoration. The stark contrast of black and white colors creates a strong visual impact, making the plum blossom image stand out in simplicity. Its minimalist design removes unnecessary decorative elements, emphasizing the core symbolic meaning of the plum blossom, conveying a sense of purity and nobility.
description.zh: 该纹样以单一梅花图案为主体，构图简洁且富有象征意义。梅花的五片花瓣对称分布，线条流畅，整体形态饱满圆润，中心以点状排列形成花蕊，突出细节装饰的精细感。黑白强烈对比的色彩设计，使梅花形象在简约中散发出明显的视觉冲击力。其极简风格去除了多余的装饰性，强调梅花的核心意象，传递了一种纯净而高洁的视觉美感。

description.en: Plum blossom has traditionally symbolized purity, resilience, and the perseverance of life. The five-petal structure represents "five blessings," bestowing positive wishes. The contrast of black and white not only highlights the plum's resistance to cold but also embodies the traditional Chinese concept of yin and yang balance, symbolizing harmony with nature and the cyclical nature of life. The pattern, in its simplicity, conveys profound cultural connotations, showcasing the perfect fusion of cultural aesthetics and philosophical perspectives.
description.zh: 梅花历来象征着高洁、坚韧与生命的顽强，在该纹样中，通过简洁的表现手法，突出了梅花的精神象征。五瓣结构寓意“五福”，赋予其美好的祝愿意义。黑白对比不仅表达了梅花不畏严寒的品性，还承载了中国传统艺术中的阴阳平衡思想，象征自然的和谐与生命的循环。图案在简约中蕴含深厚的文化内涵，展现了文化审美与哲学观的完美融合。

sourceReference: 整体-物像_中国经典纹样图鉴(黄清穗)

description.en: This jade object features a circular composition with five plum blossoms evenly distributed within. This creates a radial layout centered on the central axis. The five petals of the plum blossoms are arranged symmetrically, with smooth and gentle lines. The flower stamens are slightly emphasized, making the overall pattern clear and distinct. Plum blossoms are interspersed with stream-lined leaf patterns, which are beautiful and harmonious, creating a natural visual relationship. The edges are decorated with radial patterns, enhancing the overall sense of the circular composition. The design is simple and elegant, presenting a decorative effect of complexity without being chaotic.
description.zh: 该玉器纹样以圆形构图为基础，五朵梅花均匀分布于圆形内部，形成中心放射式布局。梅花的五瓣呈对称排列，线条流畅而柔和，花蕊位置略微突显，使整体图案层次分明。梅花间点缀有流线型叶纹，叶片形态优美，与梅花构成自然生动的视觉关系。边缘部分以放射状纹理进行装饰，增强了圆形构图的整体感。整体设计显得简洁、精美，花叶交错呈现出繁而不乱的装饰美感。

description.en: This motif combines plum blossoms and leaves, showcasing reverence for life and nature's harmony in Chinese culture. The plum blossom symbolizes purity and resilience, while the streamlined leaf shape symbolizes vitality and natural flow, creating a harmonious dynamic. The circular composition represents cycles and completeness, hinting at the infinite continuation of life and natural balance. As a jade object decoration, this motif not only conveys aesthetic values but also incorporates protective and auspicious cultural meanings.
description.zh: 该纹样通过梅花与叶片的结合，展现了中国传统文化对生命力与自然和谐的尊崇。梅花寓意高洁与坚韧，象征不畏艰难的精神，叶片的流线形态则象征生命的生机与自然流动，形成了动静结合的寓意表达。圆形构图体现循环与完整，暗示生命的无尽延续以及自然的平衡。作为玉器装饰，这一纹样不仅传递了美学理念，还融入了守护与吉祥的文化意涵。

sourceReference: 玉器_中国古代玉器纹饰图典

description.en: This Ming dynasty brocade design features plum blossoms as the primary decorative elements. The flowers display vibrant red and yellow colors with contrasting hues. The five-petal arcs of the plum blossoms are evenly spread, while the center is decorated with fine textures to enhance visual complexity and intricacy. The branches are connected by flowing natural lines, creating a balanced and dynamic layout. The flowers are evenly distributed, giving the design a sense of rhythm and natural vitality. The brocade's satin texture further highlights the plum blossom pattern, radiating a sense of nobility and elegance.
description.zh: 该明代织锦纹样以梅花为主要装饰元素，花朵呈现鲜艳的红黄色彩对比，梅花五瓣弧形均匀展开，中心部分以细密纹理装饰，增强视觉复杂性与精致感。折枝纹以自然流动的线条连接梅花，使图案布局既对称有序又富有动感。花朵均匀分布，整体呈现出一种韵律感和自然活力。织锦的缎面材质将梅花纹样的色彩与纹理进一步凸显，熠熠生辉，散发出高贵与典雅的气质。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该折枝梅花纹象征中国传统文化中的生命力与自然和谐。梅花寓意品格高洁与坚韧，红黄色彩搭配传递吉祥与喜庆的意义，折枝纹的自然流动象征生命的循环与自然的运行。作为织锦装饰，这一纹样不仅体现了明代工艺的精湛，也表达了天人合一的思想，在庄重与优雅中蕴含深厚的文化内涵，适用于庆典或礼仪场合。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: This Ming dynasty red ground plum blossom brocade pattern features a plum blossom as the main decorative element. The flowers are full and round, with five-petaled blooms in a rounded arc shape. The center of the flowers is depicted with fine textures to emphasize depth. The design of the branches is characterized by short, curvilinear branches that interlace with the flowers, creating a sense of strength and vitality. The contrast between the branches and the flowers, which are soft and delicate, creates a harmonious visual effect. The overall composition is balanced in density, with flowers distributed evenly but still imbued with a sense of movement, reflecting the natural growth rhythm. The surface texture of the brocade is fine, contrasting with the colors of the background to enhance the three-dimensionality of the pattern, making the plum blossoms and the branches more decorative.
description.zh: 该明代红地折枝梅花锦纹样以梅花为主要装饰元素，花朵形态饱满，五瓣花瓣呈圆润弧形，中心花蕊以细腻纹理表现层次感，构造精致。枝干的设计以短折枝形式穿插于花朵之间，枝条线条遒劲有力，与梅花的柔美形成刚柔相济的视觉对比。整体构图疏密有致，花朵分布均匀但又富有灵动感，呈现了自然生长的韵律。织锦表面质感细腻，背景的色彩与纹样的对比强化了图案的立体感，使梅花与折枝更具装饰效果。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该纹样通过梅花与折枝的结合，体现了中国传统文化中生命力与自然的哲学意境。梅花象征高洁与坚韧，枝干的遒劲造型则展现了力量与支撑的精神。梅花间的疏密布局及枝干穿插，表达了自然运行与循环的秩序感，同时寓意生命在逆境中的绽放与和谐之美。作为织锦装饰，这一纹样传递了对美好自然的敬仰与生命力的赞美。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

title.en: Red-Ground Flowering Spray Plum Blossom Pattern

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该宋代丝织纹样以几何构图为核心，包含方胜纹、“卐”字纹、“米”字纹、梅花和树叶等多种主题元素。这些元素间通过直线与曲线、线与面相互交织，形成紧凑而统一的布局。方胜纹与“卐”字纹排列规整，表现出强烈的几何美感；梅花与树叶通过柔和的曲线融入其中，为整体增添自然灵动的点缀。纹样以对比的方式展现了线条的严谨与意象的柔美，使装饰效果显得均衡而富有层次感。

description.en: This motif combines geometric patterns with natural imagery, reflecting China's traditional pursuit of order and harmony with nature. The motifs include "fang sheng" (square pendants) and "xuan" (swastika) symbols, which symbolize cycles and eternity, representing the laws of things and stability. The plum blossom and leaves symbolize vitality and natural beauty, softening the formal aspects of the motifs. The overall motif praises life and nature, conveying expectations of auspiciousness and protection. This design is commonly found in high-end silk textiles from the Song dynasty, highlighting identity and cultural connotations.
description.zh: 该纹样通过几何图案与自然意象结合，体现了中国传统文化对秩序与自然和谐的追求。几何纹饰方胜、“卐”字等象征循环与永恒，表达事物运行的规律与稳定；梅花与树叶则象征生命力与自然之美，柔化了几何图案的严肃感。整体纹样既展现了对生命与自然的礼赞，也传递了对吉祥与守护的期待。这种设计常见于宋代高端丝织品中，用于凸显身份与文化意涵。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

title.en: Plum Blossom Interlocking-Lozenge Wan Character Pattern

place.en: Fuzhou suburb of the northern outskirts of Fuzhou, Fujian province

description.en: The Song Dynasty plum blossom brocade ball with interlaced scroll as the main composition. The interlaced scroll uses smooth curves to express the theme of interlaced scroll, integrating the plum blossoms naturally, presenting a lively and elegant atmosphere. The brocade ball is interwoven with the branches, creating a visual effect of decoration and connection, making the object and flowers blend together. The pattern is presented in a four-sided continuous arrangement, presenting overall and extended characteristics, with proper density and spacing, maintaining a harmonious relationship between the images while also presenting variety. The softness of the plum blossoms and the sense of movement of the interlaced scroll complement each other, complemented by the exquisite design of the object's pattern, making the pattern stand out uniquely in the Song Dynasty brocade pattern.
description.zh: 该宋代梅花彩球纹绫以梅花缠枝为主要构图元素，缠枝采用流畅的曲线表现，与梅花自然结合，展现生动优雅的意境。绣球装饰穿插在枝蔓之间，形成点缀与连接的视觉效果，使器物与花卉融为一体。纹样通过四方连续的排列方式呈现整体性和延展性，布局疏密得当，意象之间的关系既协调又富于变化。梅花的柔美与缠枝的动感相辅相成，搭配器物图案的精巧设计，令纹样在宋代绫纹中显得别致而独特。

description.en: This motif, combining plum blossoms, interlaced scrolls, and objects, conveys cultural meanings of vitality and cyclical harmony. The plum blossoms symbolize resilience and purity, the interlaced scrolls represent the dynamic natural movement, and the brocade ball expresses auspiciousness and protection. The symmetrical layout of the four corners embodies the order and harmony of the universe and nature, reflecting the philosophical contemplation of the Song Dynasty on nature and life. This motif has dual value, enhancing the aesthetic appeal of silk textiles while carrying profound cultural symbolism.
description.zh: 该纹样通过梅花、缠枝和器物的结合，传递了生命力与自然循环的文化寓意。梅花象征坚韧与高洁，缠枝呈现生机勃勃的自然动态，绣球装饰则表达吉祥与护佑的意义。四方连续的构图体现了天地间运行的秩序与和谐，同时展现了宋代对自然与生命的哲学思考。这种纹样在装饰性与文化内涵上具有双重价值，既美化丝织物，又承载深刻的文化意象。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

title.en: Plum Blossom and Interlaced Scroll Pattern

description.en: This motif features two birds perched on curved branches, forming a harmonious scene between nature and life. The birds stand side by side on the branches, with their wings flowing in a streamlined form, showcasing delicate feathers and clear body outlines. The branches extend from the bottom to the sides, with ball-like buds and open plum blossoms on the tips, presenting petals in an arc shape. The delicate petals and the bird's posture create a serene and elegant visual effect, complementing the dynamic lines of the branches. The flowers and branches interweave, creating a rhythmic movement, with the bird and the branches forming the visual focal point, resulting in a compact and layered composition. The overall design is decorative, with the branches flowing and the plum blossoms lively, showcasing the birds' natural vitality.
description.zh: 该纹样以两只鸟和周围的梅花花枝为主要构图元素，形成自然与生命的和谐场景。两只鸟并排站立在弯曲的枝条上，呈流线型姿态，羽翼细腻，身体轮廓清晰。枝条自下方向两侧延展，枝头点缀着球状花蕾和开放的梅花，花瓣呈弧形，娴静柔美，与枝条的动态线条相互呼应。花朵与枝条交错排列，形成灵动的节奏感，鸟与花枝的组合成为视觉中心，呈现出紧凑而层次分明的布局。整体设计富有装饰性，枝条流畅，梅花生动，鸟的姿态自然生机勃勃。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 纹样通过两只鸟与梅花的自然结合，传递了中国传统文化中生命、和谐与自然的深刻意涵。梅花象征坚韧与高洁，花枝的生长动态体现自然循环的规律，而两只鸟的并排姿态则寓意和谐与温暖的情感纽带。枝条的延展与花蕾的点缀象征生命力的生长与绽放，整体构图表达了人们对生活美好与自然和谐的追求。这种纹样不仅具有装饰性，同时也体现了文化中的情感关怀与自然哲学。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

description.en: The motif is centered on the character "hong xi" (meaning "hong" for "red" and "xi" for "joy"), with symmetrical decoration of two birds on either side, and a few plum blossoms and branches of leaves below. The overall layout is balanced and decorated. The "hong xi" character is placed in the center of the image, with a square and symmetrical structure, making it stable and eye-catching. The birds' heads face inward, forming a visual connection, while their bodies are curved, with wings spread and tail feathers depicted delicately. The plum blossoms are simple, arranged in a curvilinear pattern, and extend outward from the blossoms, with soft lines complementing the bird's curved forms. All elements are interrelated in terms of structure and form, resulting in a compact and harmonious visual effect. The motif conveys a strong and lively message.
description.zh: 该纹样以“囍”字为中心构图，两侧对称装饰两只鸟，下方点缀梅花和枝叶，整体布局均衡且富有装饰性。“囍”字位于画面中央，结构方正对称，稳重而醒目。两只鸟头部向内，形成呼应，身体呈弧形，翅膀展开，尾部羽毛刻画细腻，姿态灵动自然。下方的梅花花瓣简洁，呈弧形层叠排列，枝叶从梅花处向外延展，线条柔美，与鸟的曲线造型相得益彰。各元素在结构与形态上互相呼应，呈现出紧凑而和谐的视觉效果，寓意鲜明、生动。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该纹样通过“囍”字与鸟、梅花的组合，传递了传统文化中对喜庆、吉祥与和谐的祈愿。“囍”代表婚嫁与庆典中美满幸福的象征，梅花象征坚韧与高洁，鸟的对称姿态则寓意家庭和睦、喜上眉梢。枝叶的自然延展表达生命力的勃发，契合了中国传统文化中对自然与生命的礼赞。整体纹样不仅具有装饰性，更承载了人们对幸福生活的美好期盼，是一种独特的文化表达。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

title.en: Magpie on a Plum Branch Motif

description.en: This paper-cut design centers on plum blossoms, complemented by branches, birds, and clouds. The composition is compact and layered, with the plum blossoms arranged in five petals, evenly distributed, and bursting into the interwoven branches. The branch lines are smooth, showcasing the natural dynamic beauty, creating a soft harmony with the plum blossoms. The bird on the right side has a lively posture, with wings spread into a streamlined shape, and the tail feathers are delicate and beautiful, as if it is flying over the blossoms, infusing the scene with vitality. The clouds in the background are composed of arcs and waves, surrounding the overall structure of the design, enhancing the decorative and spatial qualities of the image. The interplay of elements is harmonious and well-organized, creating a lively and natural scene.
description.zh: 该剪纸纹样以梅花为视觉中心，同时辅以枝条、鸟和背景的祥云，整体构图紧凑而富有层次感。梅花呈五瓣形状，分布均匀，花朵饱满且轮廓清晰，盛开于交错延展的枝条上。枝条线条流畅，展现出自然的动态美感，与梅花形成柔美的呼应。右侧的鸟姿态灵动，翅膀展开呈流线型，尾羽优美细致，仿佛掠过梅花，赋予画面生机。背景的祥云以弧线和波纹组成，环绕图案的整体结构，增强了画面的装饰性和空间感。各元素之间相互呼应，布局和谐有序，共同构成一幅生动自然的画面。

description.en: This motif combines the plum blossom, birds, branches, and clouds into a cycle of harmony and peace. The plum blossom symbolizes purity and resilience, the birds' grace and agility convey joy and happiness, and the clouds are often a symbol of good fortune, reflecting peace and well-being. The natural extension of the branches and the blossoming of flowers represent vitality and the cycle of life, while the birds' presence in the plum blossom symbolizes "joy on the face," a wish for happiness. This motif not only embodies the natural vitality but also integrates people's fervent desire for a good life.
description.zh: 该纹样通过梅花、鸟、枝条和祥云的巧妙结合，传递了中国传统文化中对美好生活的追求和自然和谐的赞颂。梅花象征高洁与坚韧，鸟的轻盈灵动寓意喜庆与幸福，而祥云则常为吉祥的象征，彰显平安与福祉。枝条的自然延展与花朵的绽放表现了生命力的蓬勃与循环，鸟在梅花间的点缀则隐喻“喜上眉梢”的美好祝愿。这种纹样不仅体现了自然的生机，也融入了人们对幸福生活的热切期盼。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

title.en: Magpie on a Plum Branch Motif

description.en: This paper cut design features plum blossoms and willow trees as its primary visual elements, complemented by two swallows and a layer of cloud patterns. The design is bordered by a regular X-patterned border, creating a balanced and flowing composition. The plum blossoms are concentrated in the lower and central areas of the image, with their petals arranged in a five-petal shape, densely filling the interwoven branches. This highlights the natural abundance and vitality. The willow branches, with their soft, flowing lines, interweave with the plum blossoms, adding a sense of lightness and fluidity to the artwork. Two swallows are positioned in the center, one flapping its wings, while the other perches on a branch. Their varied postures interact with the flowers and branches. The background's layered cloud patterns enhance the spatial sense, while the X-patterned border adds a sense of order and unity to the composition. The interplay of all elements is harmonious, creating a visually pleasing effect.
description.zh: 该剪纸纹样以梅花和柳树为主要视觉元素，同时辅以两只燕子和层叠云纹，外围由规则的回字纹边框装饰，整体构图均衡流畅，充满动感。梅花集中分布于画面下方和中间区域，花朵呈小巧的五瓣形状，密集地排列在交错延展的枝条上，展现出自然的繁盛与生机。柳树垂下柔软的枝条，与梅花枝条自然交织，线条轻盈灵动，增加画面优雅的韵律感。两只燕子位于画面中部，一只展翅飞翔，另一只停栖在柳枝上，姿态各异，与周围的花朵和树枝产生互动。背景的云纹层叠环绕，增强空间感，外围回字纹边框则使画面富有规整和整体性，各装饰元素之间协调一致，营造出和谐美好的视觉效果。

description.en: This motif combines plum blossoms, willow trees, swallows, and clouds, reflecting the Chinese tradition's love for nature and praise of life. The plum blossoms symbolize purity and resilience, the willow branches symbolize vitality and harmony, the swallows represent joy and family happiness, and the clouds convey auspiciousness and tranquility. The interaction of swallows with willow branches metaphorically represents "joy on the face," expressing a wish for a good life. The overall motif not only embodies the harmonious relationship between natural elements but also deeply conveys the profound understanding of happiness, life, and cycles in traditional culture. This motif embodies people's aspirations and blessings for a good life.
description.zh: 该纹样通过梅花、柳树、燕子和云纹的组合，展现了中国传统文化中对自然的热爱与生命的礼赞。梅花象征高洁与坚韧生命力，柳树柔美的垂枝寓意生机与和谐，两只燕子代表喜庆与家庭幸福，云纹则寄托吉祥与安宁之意。同时，燕子与柳枝的互动隐喻“喜上眉梢”，表达对美好生活的祈愿。整体纹样不仅体现了自然元素之间的和谐关系，也传递了传统文化中对幸福、生命与循环的深刻理解。这种纹样承载了人们对美好生活的向往与祝福。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

description.en: This paper cut design features two plum blossoms as the primary visual elements. The trunk of each tree is placed on either side of the image, with thick and twisted branches that create a sense of movement. The branches interlace, presenting a harmonious and symmetrical layout. The flowers bloom in a circular pattern, with uniform sizes and intricate petals. The entire composition is vibrant and full of vitality. Two birds are perched on the branches of the two plum blossoms, facing each other. Their wings and positions vary, showcasing a sense of natural movement. The bottom of the image features a mountain shape, which echoes the plum blossoms, adding depth and a natural atmosphere. The overall composition is symmetrical and compact, with harmonious relationships between elements, resulting in a decorative and aesthetically pleasing design.
description.zh: 该剪纸纹样以两棵梅花树为主要视觉元素，树干位于画面左右两侧，粗壮而扭曲，呈现自然的流动感，同时向中间延展，枝条交错排列，柔美而灵动。枝条上开满许多圆形的梅花，花朵大小均匀，花瓣细致，整个画面显得繁盛而生机勃勃。两只鸟分别栖息在左右两棵梅花树的枝条上，身体方向相对，形成一种和谐的对称布局，展翅和栖息的姿态各有特点，透露出自然的动态美感。画面底部的山形元素与梅花树的形态呼应，使画面具有层次感和浓厚的自然意境。整体纹样构图对称而紧凑，各元素之间关系和谐，富有装饰性和艺术美感。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该纹样通过梅花树、鸟和山形元素的组合，传递了中国传统文化中对自然与生命的崇敬，以及对和谐美好生活的追求。梅花象征坚韧与高洁，鸟的存在则寓意喜庆与幸福，而山形元素则体现稳定与长久的意味。两只鸟相对而立，隐喻“喜上眉梢”，表达对幸福生活的美好愿望。整体纹样不仅展现了自然元素的和谐关系，还以其对称构图和生动意象赋予画面吉祥与平安的寓意，体现了传统文化对生命、自然和循环的深刻理解。

sourceReference: 民间_古今图案集成：古代卷（无文字）（杨棣）

title.en: Magpie on a Plum Branch Motif

description.en: The motif features a chrysanthemum as the primary subject, presenting a symmetrical circular composition. The chrysanthemum's petals radiate outward from the center in a radial arrangement, forming a neat and orderly pattern. The petals' curves are smooth and consistent, creating a wave-like visual effect. Each petal is uniform in width and curvature, contributing to a strong sense of rhythm and depth. The overall design exudes a vibrant and orderly aesthetic, reminiscent of the chrysanthemum's full bloom. The abstract design is highly decorative and artistic, capturing the essence of natural beauty and order.
description.zh: 该纹样以菊花为主要意象，呈现出圆形的对称构图，整体简洁而精致。菊花的花瓣从中心向外均匀放射，排列紧密而有序，花瓣的弧线优美弯曲，形成波浪状的动感效果。每一片花瓣宽窄均匀，弧度一致，整体造型呈现出强烈的节奏感与层次感，仿佛菊花在盛开时的绚丽姿态。中心部分紧凑，向外逐渐舒展，构建了流畅的视觉引导，体现自然生机与秩序美感。图案设计高度抽象化，具有强烈的装饰性和艺术性。

description.en: This motif, featuring chrysanthemum patterns, praises the Chinese tradition of high moral integrity and vitality. Chrysanthemums symbolize resilience and longevity, representing the noble qualities of not fearing adversity, and are closely associated with autumn, reflecting the natural seasonal cycle. The symmetrical composition and radial arrangement within the motif express the harmony of nature and the cosmic order. The overall motif not only conveys the aesthetic symbolism of chrysanthemums but also deeply interprets the profound understanding of vitality, natural cycles, and coordination.
description.zh: 该纹样通过菊花的图案化设计，传递了中国传统文化中对高洁品格与生命力的礼赞。菊花在中国文化中象征着坚韧与长寿，代表不畏逆境的高尚情操，同时也与秋季联系紧密，体现自然的季节性循环。纹样中对称的构图与辐射状的排列则表达了自然的和谐美与宇宙的运行秩序。整体纹样不仅展现了菊花的美学意象，也蕴含着对生命力、自然循环以及协调平衡的深刻理解。

sourceReference: 整体-物像_中国经典纹样图鉴(黄清穗)

description.en: This brocade pattern features chrysanthemums and geometric motifs. The overall composition is symmetrical, with a grid of intersecting rhombuses as the main framework. The interior of the grid is filled with various decorative patterns such as meanders, clouds, and petal patterns. The central part of the image features a cluster of blooming chrysanthemums. The petals of the chrysanthemums are layered and detailed, capturing the vitality of nature, interweaving with the leaves. The rhombus grid edges are complemented by simple geometric decorations, creating a visual contrast with the soft floral patterns. This results in a dynamic yet harmonious composition that is both decorative and rhythmic.
description.zh: 该织锦纹样以菊花和几何图案为主体，整体呈现规整的对称布局。画面以相交的菱形网格为主框架，网格内部填充有多种装饰图案，如回纹、云纹和花瓣纹，中间点缀着盛开的菊花簇。菊花的花瓣层层叠叠，细致而饱满，呈现出自然的生命力，与枝叶交错分布，构成极具动态美感的造型。菱形网格的边缘辅以简洁的几何装饰，与柔美的花卉图案形成视觉上的对比，使整个画面既富有装饰性又具备和谐的节奏感。

description.en: This motif combines chrysanthemum and geometric patterns, reflecting the harmonious fusion of natural beauty and order in traditional Chinese decorative arts. Chrysanthemum symbolizes purity, longevity, and vitality, symbolizing people's aspirations for a better life. The diamond-shaped grid and geometric patterns symbolize stability and coordination, conveying the pursuit of order and harmony. The overall composition not only embodies the vitality and flourishing of nature and life but also showcases the harmonious coexistence of humans and nature in traditional Chinese culture, highlighting the exquisite and refined qualities of Qing dynasty brocade art.
description.zh: 该纹样融合了菊花和几何图案，体现出中国传统装饰艺术中自然之美与秩序之美的交融。菊花在中国文化中象征着高洁、长寿与生命力，寄托着人们对美好生活的向往。菱形网格和几何纹样则寓意稳固与协调，传递出对秩序与和谐的追求。整体构图不仅体现了自然和生命的蓬勃生机，也展现了传统文化中人与自然和谐共处的美好意境，彰显了清代织锦艺术的精致与典雅。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该织锦纹样以菊花和“寿”字为核心意象，整体呈现出紧凑且富有装饰性的垂直排列结构。菊花图案层次分明，花瓣饱满且排列均匀，展现出盛开的形态，枝叶交错点缀，增强画面的自然生机。文字“寿”以方正的书法形式融入其中，与菊花交替排列，形成节奏感鲜明的布局。菊花与“寿”字的组合在视觉上既突出重点，又保持装饰纹样的均衡和美感。黑色背景对纹样主体进行衬托，使菊花和“寿”字在画面中更加醒目，整体纹样富有典雅庄重的气息。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 该纹样融合了菊花和汉字“寿”，传递了中国传统文化中对长寿、福禄和生命力的祝愿。菊花象征着高洁和坚韧，同时寓意长寿，与“寿”字的主题相契合。文字与自然意象的结合体现了中国装饰艺术中常见的寓意表达方式——将美学与文化理念融为一体。纹样构图的对称性和有序性象征着和谐与稳定，同时表达了对生命循环与自然运行规律的尊重。在清代，菊花与“寿”字纹样常用于礼仪用品和装饰织物，承载着祝福与吉祥的含义。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝牡丹菊花纹以牡丹、菊花与缠枝图案为主要构成元素，整体呈现优雅的对称布局。牡丹与菊花的造型写实且饱满，花瓣层层叠加，细致分明，枝叶的造型则以流畅的曲线展现缠绕与生长的动态感。花朵在纹样中占据主要视觉焦点，而枝叶延展至画面各处，形成点、线、面的协调对比。黑色背景衬托出花朵与枝叶的纹样细节，强化了图案的层次感与装饰性。纹样整体设计细腻，构图平衡，既注重写实风格，又通过缠绕枝条使画面延展，与背景形成和谐统一。

description.en: This motif, featuring peonies and chrysanthemums, embodies the Chinese tradition of pursuing prosperity, flourishing, and longevity. The peony symbolizes wealth and authority, while the chrysanthemum represents purity and vitality. Together, they convey auspiciousness and happiness. The interlaced scroll design highlights the cyclical nature of life and the perpetual renewal of nature, symbolizing harmony and longevity. The intricate patterns on Ming dynasty silk reflect the exquisite craftsmanship of decorative arts and the profound symbolic depth of Chinese culture, embodying a classic fusion of realist and symbolic artistic traditions.
description.zh: 该纹样通过牡丹和菊花展现了中国传统文化中对富贵、繁荣与长寿的追求。牡丹象征富贵与权威，是“花中之王”，菊花则代表高洁与生命力，二者结合寓意吉祥与幸福。缠枝的设计凸显了生命的循环与自然的生生不息，也传递了对和谐与永续的美好愿景。明代丝绸上的这种纹样既体现了装饰艺术的精湛工艺，也展现了文化内涵的深远意境，是中国传统织绣中写实主义与象征主义的经典结合。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Chrysanthemum and Chrysanthemum Branching Pattern: This pattern features chrysanthemums as the main subject, showcasing a realistic style with distinct layers of petals and a detailed arrangement. The stem and leaves are depicted with smooth lines conveying a sense of dynamic interlacing, layering without appearing chaotic, creating a harmonious visual relationship with the flower heads. The overall layout is structured and varied, employing an aesthetic of balance and symmetry, while the interweaving of leaves adds rhythm to the composition. The black background highlights the chrysanthemums' distinct form and fine texture, enhancing the decorative and life-like qualities of the scene.
description.zh: 缠枝菊花纹以菊花为主要题材，极具写实特色，花头层次分明，花瓣排列细致饱满，展现出菊花盛开的姿态。茎叶以流畅的线条展现缠绕的动态感，层叠交错却不显凌乱，与花头形成和谐的视觉关系。整体布局规整而富有变化，运用了均衡的对称美学，同时花叶之间的穿插使画面充满节奏感。黑色背景烘托出菊花的鲜明形态及细腻纹理，让画面充满装饰性与生命力。

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 缠枝菊花纹图案蕴含着中国传统文化中对自然与生命力的崇敬。菊花象征高洁与长寿，同时寓意坚韧不拔的品格；缠枝的设计展现了生命的循环、延续与自然的动态美。纹样整体传递了和谐与生生不息的文化精神，体现了中国装饰艺术中以自然意象表达文化内涵的独特魅力。作为明代丝绸上的典型纹样，该图案不仅彰显织绣工艺的精湛，也寄托了对生命与自然运行的尊重与热爱。

sourceReference: 织染-辞典_中国历代服装、染织、刺绣辞典(吴山)

description.en: Whirlpool cloud pattern with continuous rotation of vortex patterns as the main body, featuring a regular and intricate layout, primarily characterized by symmetry. The main body of the motif presents a continuous vortex pattern, with curling lines forming a series of concentric circles, imbuing the pattern with dynamism. The morphological form of the vortex gradually emerges from the curves, creating a visual effect of curling and unfolding, with variations in line thickness and density of the motif contributing to a sense of depth and complexity. The whirlpool cloud pattern seamlessly integrates with the form of the vessel, effectively filling its shape, thus achieving a unity of decoration and practicality.
description.zh: 涡状云纹以曲线构成的涡旋图案为主体，整体布局规则且精巧，以对称性为主要特征。纹样主体呈现连续旋转的涡状图案，卷曲的线条层层环绕，充满动态感。涡旋的形态在曲线中逐渐生发，形成云纹的卷曲与舒展的视觉效果，线条的粗细变化与纹样的疏密安排使图案富有立体感和层次感。涡状云纹与器物表面的形态紧密结合，巧妙地填充了器物的形状，使整体装饰与实用功能融为一体。

description.en: The swirling cloud pattern symbolizes the movement of natural clouds, closely related to ancient beliefs in the cyclical nature of heaven and earth and the cosmic movement. This motif reflects the worship of natural elements by the Zhou Dynasty, with the cloud pattern as a symbol of harmony between heaven and earth. The cyclic rotation of the pattern embodies the endless continuation of life and the universe, reflecting reverence for the forces of cyclical flow. As a decorative motif on bronze objects, it also imbues the vessel with a sense of solemn mystery, reinforcing the symbolic meanings of authority and etiquette.
description.zh: 涡状云纹象征了自然界的云气流动，与古代对天地循环和宇宙运行的理解息息相关。这种纹样体现了春秋时期人们对自然元素的崇拜，云纹作为祥瑞之象，象征天人合一与自然运行的和谐。纹样的循环旋转表现了生命与宇宙的无尽延续，承载了对循环流转之力的敬畏。作为铜器上的装饰纹样，它也赋予器物庄重神秘的气息，强化了权威与礼仪的象征意义。

sourceReference: 金属器_晋国青铜艺术图鉴（李夏廷）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 勾连云纹以连续排列的云纹形式构成，整体布局规整且富有秩序感。纹样主体呈现勾连的旋转云形，每个云纹以螺旋状展开，线条流畅而整齐，边缘轮廓比例均衡，纹样间呈紧密连接的形式，形成连续不断的装饰带。云纹的流线形态展现了动态的视觉效果，线条的闭合与延展使整体充满节奏感与韵律美。该纹样通过重复与延续的构造填满了器物表面，既起到装饰作用，又与器物的用途和形状相结合。

description.en: The cloud pattern on the Guǐwen symbolizes ancient reverence for the cyclical movement of nature and the universe. The cloud motif represents the movement of celestial clouds, closely linked to the ancient concept of harmonizing heaven and earth, signifying the ceaseless vitality of nature's cycles. This continuous pattern further emphasizes the cyclical nature of the universe and the enduring power of natural forces, connecting the cosmos and life in a harmonious manner. As a decorative motif on bronze objects from the Spring and Autumn period, it also carries the authority symbol of rituals and ceremonies, highlighting the sanctity and grandeur of the vessel.
description.zh: 勾连云纹蕴含着古代对自然与宇宙循环运行的崇敬与表达。云纹象征天上云气的流动，与古代天人合一的观念息息相关，代表了自然的运行与循环不息的生命力。这种纹样的连续连接形式进一步强调了宇宙循环与自然力量的永恒，勾连之势也体现了和谐与连贯的文化价值观。作为春秋时期铜器上的装饰纹样，它还承载了祭祀与礼仪中的权威象征，突显器物的庄严与神圣。

sourceReference: 金属器_晋国青铜艺术图鉴（李夏廷）

description.en: Repeating oblique angles with whorl patterns form the main motif, characterized by a strong geometric and decorative feature. The main motif consists of multiple sharp angles and rotating whorls. The oblique part has a directional sense resembling arrows, contrasting sharply with the smooth, circular lines of the whorls. Embedded within the oblique edges or interiors, the whorls are finely detailed and layered, creating a dynamic visual effect while maintaining tension. The overall composition is structured by the regular arrangement of geometric shapes combined with flowing whorls, emphasizing continuity and the overall design, while highlighting the intricate and detailed decorative patterns.
description.zh: 复式斜角云纹以复杂的斜角形和涡状云纹组合构成，整体具有强烈的几何特征与装饰性。纹样的主体由多组锐角与旋转涡纹组成，斜角部分呈现出箭头般的延展感，与涡旋云纹的圆润线条形成鲜明对比。涡状云纹被嵌入斜角的边缘或内部，线条细腻且层次分明，使画面既有动态感，又富有视觉张力。整体构图通过规则排列的几何形状结合流动的云纹，强调连续性与整体性，同时突出装饰纹样的精致与复杂。

description.en: Repeating oblique cloud pattern from the Spring and Autumn period reflects a profound understanding of the natural world, cosmic movement, and authority. The cloud pattern symbolizes celestial auspiciousness, connected to ancient rituals and ceremonies, while the sharp angles and arrow-like forms carry awe-inspiring and authoritative connotations. The intricate pattern conveys the symbolic representation of order and power, while the fluid movement of the pattern symbolizes the continuation of natural cycles and life. As decorative patterns on bronze objects, it not only expresses the pursuit of cosmic harmony but also embodies the ritual functions and social status of the vessel.
description.zh: 复式斜角云纹体现了春秋时期对自然、宇宙运行及权威力量的深刻理解。云纹象征天上的祥瑞，与古代祭祀及礼仪中的神圣概念相连，而斜角的尖锐和箭头形态则带有震慑与威严的象征意义。纹样的复杂构造暗含秩序与权力的象征，同时云纹的流动形态展现了自然循环与生命力的延续。作为铜器表面的装饰纹样，它不仅传达了对天地和谐的追求，还体现了器物的礼仪功能与社会地位。

sourceReference: 金属器_晋国青铜艺术图鉴（李夏廷）

description.en: Translation pending
description.zh: 卷叶形斜角云纹以卷叶纹与斜角云纹相间排列构成，呈现出一种流动与延展的视觉韵律。卷叶纹的形态柔美，线条呈弧形卷曲，犹如生机盎然的植物叶片；而斜角云纹则以锐利的直线和尖角结构展现出一种张力，两者形成了柔与刚的对比。纹样通过均匀间隔的排列增强了装饰带的连续性，卷叶纹与云纹之间形成了互补的关系，使纹样既富有自然的灵动之美，又具有几何的秩序感。

description.en: Scrolling leaf-shaped oblique cloud pattern symbolizes the combination of natural vitality and cosmic cycle. The scroll pattern represents the prosperity of plant growth and the vitality of life, while the cloud pattern embodies the worship of heavenly auspicious air and the movement of nature. The interweaving of the two patterns conveys the concept of harmony between heaven and earth, reflecting the harmony of nature and life, as well as the profound faith of the Spring and Autumn period in the continuation of life and the cycle of the universe. As decorative patterns on bronze objects, it also plays a role in highlighting authority and the solemnity of rituals, reflecting the functions and hierarchy of ritual vessels.
